## 本报告的立场、血统与边界

本报告是《a168风控与客户分层评分体系_商业方案》（**主方案**，父）与
《a168风控评分_精要商业报告》（**精要版**，子）之下的**专题分册**，
只答先生本次点名的三件事，不重述两档已成之结论：

1. **读取关键数据表**——读了哪几张、各有哪些维度、每一维的行业正名，**全维度直接呈现、逐维悬停**；
2. **能力值追溯矩阵**——每一维能力值，从领域、赏罚方向、原始量表达式，一路追到料源表、料源列与其**本次是否在位**；
3. **玩家／荷官／代理三实体**——各领域能力值雷达、能力值名单、四族风险名录（异常 IP · 尾秒下注 · 对打 · 同桌率）
   及其判定标准与指标、名录全维度，并核算其在**营业额**与**盈亏**两侧的量。

**血统纪律（五档一族，改一档须同步其余四档）**

| 档 | 角色 | 与本档之关系 |
|---|---|---|
| `a168风控与客户分层评分体系_商业方案.qmd` | 主方案（父） | 维度字典（§17.2）、统一领域本体 D01–D12、口径裁定之权威出处 |
| `a168风控评分_精要商业报告.qmd` | 精要版（子） | 能力值算法（分位归一 · 赏−罚）与 `er_radar()` 雷达实现之出处，本档一字不改地承用 |
| `a168_取数与核验_SQL总包_v3.sql` | 取数层（料源） | 本档一切数字之唯一料源；契约锁列由其输出 |
| `a168_能力值口径解读_SQL转R.qmd` | 对照本（校验） | 口径逐条对照与同源同值指纹自检 |
| **本档** | **专题分册（孙）** | 承上二档之数据契约、维度字典与全部纪律，只做「维度 · 追溯 · 名录 · 结账」四事 |

**四条先说破的边界，全篇有效**

- **一切数字渲染现算**。凡料源未就位者，一律以占位表点名「所待文件 · SQL 编号 · 受影响输出」，
  **绝不以合成数据、近似量或记忆中的旧数字顶替**。
- **名录是调查候选，不是定罪。** 四族名录皆为筛查信号；判定须另有结构证据与人工复核。
- **本报告的经济量是「会计差额」，不是「因果损失」**——证据等级 **E3**。
  「若该群体表现同于全体」是**情景基准**，非反事实；真实增减益须随机对照实验方能结账（见 @sec-limit）。
- **尾秒下注一族**：主方案 §E1 已裁定其信息优势**未能证实**（五重检验含 Simpson 分解与符号检验）。
  故本报告的尾秒名录**只作画像**，其经济量**一律不计入漏损合计**，并单列其检验结果。

**禁读清单（永久）**：`候选_同桌异常_最终版_已去重.csv` **不得读取**——
该件无可追溯的生成声明，且疑有局键塌缩污染。本报告的同桌率一族一律取
`R02_same_table.csv`（SQL §R02）现算，绝不取用该件。
:::

```{r}
## ══ 编码出口闸 u8()：R 符号表在 Windows 中文 locale 下以 GBK 存中文，
##    jsonlite 序列化时会静默丢弃非法字节（维名自中间消失）。凡出口一律过此闸。
u8 <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x); if (!length(x)) return(x)
  need <- !is.na(x) & !validUTF8(x)
  if (any(need)) {
    for (fr in c("", "GB18030", "GBK", "CP936", "latin1")) {
      y <- suppressWarnings(iconv(x[need], from = fr, to = "UTF-8"))
      if (!any(is.na(y))) { x[need] <- y; break }
    }
    x[is.na(x)] <- "?"
  }
  enc2utf8(x)
}
u8df <- function(d) {
  if (!is.data.frame(d)) return(d)
  names(d) <- u8(names(d))
  for (cc in which(vapply(d, is.character, TRUE))) d[[cc]] <- u8(d[[cc]])
  d
}

## ══ 数据目录：按序搜寻，取第一个存在者（与两档父报告同一惯例）
DATA_DIR <- NULL
for (cand in c("数据库", file.path("..", "数据库"), file.path("data", "数据库"),
               "database", ".")) {
  if (dir.exists(cand) &&
      length(list.files(cand, pattern = "\\.csv$", ignore.case = TRUE))) {
    DATA_DIR <- cand; break
  }
}
OUT_DIR <- file.path(if (is.null(DATA_DIR)) "." else DATA_DIR, "_名录导出")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

## ══ 禁读清单（永久铁律）：无生成声明或疑有污染者，读取即违纪
FORBIDDEN <- c("候选_同桌异常_最终版_已去重.csv")

## ══ 编码自适应读取（承精要版成法）：只探首行字节定编码，绝不「读完全表再重读」
read_any <- function(name, select = NULL, must = NULL) {
  if (is.null(DATA_DIR)) return(NULL)
  fn <- paste0(name, ".csv")
  if (fn %in% FORBIDDEN) {
    message(sprintf("⛔ [%s] 在禁读清单内，本报告不予读取（无生成声明／疑局键塌缩）", fn))
    return(NULL)
  }
  p <- file.path(DATA_DIR, fn)
  if (!file.exists(p)) {                       # 忽略大小写与前缀近似（另存变体）
    fs <- list.files(DATA_DIR)
    ci <- fs[tolower(fs) == tolower(fn)]
    if (length(ci)) p <- file.path(DATA_DIR, ci[1]) else {
      cand <- fs[startsWith(tolower(fs), tolower(name)) &
                 grepl("\\.csv$", fs, ignore.case = TRUE)]
      cand <- setdiff(cand, FORBIDDEN)
      if (!length(cand)) return(NULL)
      p <- file.path(DATA_DIR, cand[which.max(file.info(file.path(DATA_DIR, cand))$size)])
      message(sprintf("ℹ️ [%s] 前缀近似命中：%s", name, basename(p)))
    }
  }
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  con <- file(p, "rb"); raw1 <- readBin(con, "raw", 65536L); close(con)
  nl <- which(raw1 == as.raw(10L))[1]; if (is.na(nl)) nl <- length(raw1) + 1L
  hdr_raw <- rawToChar(raw1[seq_len(nl - 1L)])
  pickenc <- NULL; hdr <- NULL
  for (enc in c("UTF-8", "GB18030", "GBK", "BIG5", "latin1")) {
    h <- try(suppressWarnings(iconv(hdr_raw, from = enc, to = "UTF-8")), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(h, "try-error") || is.na(h)) next
    v <- trimws(strsplit(sub("^\ufeff", "", h), ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
    v <- gsub('^"|"$', "", v)
    if (!length(v) || any(grepl("\uFFFD", v))) next
    if (!is.null(must) && !all(enc2utf8(must) %in% v)) next
    pickenc <- enc; hdr <- v; break
  }
  if (is.null(pickenc)) {
    message(sprintf("⛔ [%s] 首行编码探测全败%s——本表不装载", name,
      if (is.null(must)) "" else sprintf("（须含列：%s）", paste(must, collapse = "、"))))
    return(NULL)
  }
  sel <- if (pickenc == "UTF-8") select else NULL
  x <- NULL
  if (HAS$dt) {
    x <- try(suppressWarnings(data.table::fread(p, select = sel, showProgress = FALSE,
           encoding = if (pickenc == "UTF-8") "UTF-8" else "unknown")), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(x, "try-error")) x <- NULL else x <- as.data.frame(x)
  }
  if (is.null(x)) {
    x <- try(suppressWarnings(utils::read.csv(p,
           fileEncoding = if (pickenc == "latin1") "latin1" else pickenc,
           check.names = FALSE)), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(x, "try-error")) { message(sprintf("⛔ [%s] 读取失败", name)); return(NULL) }
  } else {
    if (pickenc != "UTF-8")
      for (cc in which(vapply(x, is.character, TRUE)))
        x[[cc]] <- suppressWarnings(iconv(x[[cc]], from = pickenc, to = "UTF-8"))
    if (is.null(sel) && length(hdr) == ncol(x)) names(x) <- hdr
    else if (pickenc != "UTF-8")
      names(x) <- suppressWarnings(iconv(names(x), from = pickenc, to = "UTF-8"))
  }
  attr(x, "全列名") <- hdr           # ★ Schema 证据：与实际读入列解耦，不受 select 截断
  attr(x, "文件")   <- basename(p)
  attr(x, "编码")   <- pickenc
  if (!is.null(select) && is.null(sel)) x <- x[, intersect(select, names(x)), drop = FALSE]
  if (!is.null(must) && !all(enc2utf8(must) %in% enc2utf8(names(x)))) {
    message(sprintf("⛔ [%s] 契约列缺失：%s——本表不装载（契约锁）", name,
      paste(setdiff(enc2utf8(must), enc2utf8(names(x))), collapse = "、")))
    return(NULL)
  }
  message(sprintf("✅ [%s] %s · %s 行 × %d 列 · %.1f 秒", name, pickenc,
    format(nrow(x), big.mark = ","), ncol(x),
    as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))))
  x
}

## ══ 取列闸：缺列不得静默，亦不得停摆——点名登记 ＋ NA 占位 ＋ 汇总成表
GAPS <- new.env(parent = emptyenv()); GAPS$rows <- list()
pick <- function(df, cols, src = deparse(substitute(df)), impact = "") {
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  miss <- setdiff(cols, names(df))
  if (length(miss)) {
    GAPS$rows[[length(GAPS$rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(check.names = FALSE,
      来源表 = src, 缺列 = paste(miss, collapse = "、"),
      在列 = paste(utils::head(setdiff(names(df), cols), 8), collapse = "、"),
      受影响输出 = if (nzchar(impact)) impact else "（未标注）", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    message(sprintf("⛔ [%s] 缺列：%s → 受影响：%s（按 NA 占位，已登记）",
                    src, paste(miss, collapse = "、"), impact))
    for (m in miss) df[[m]] <- NA
  }
  df[, cols, drop = FALSE]
}
## ══ 别名裁决：同义异名列（口径变更的常见入口）一律显式裁决并登记，杜绝「隐性夺权」
ALIAS <- new.env(parent = emptyenv()); ALIAS$rows <- list()
col1 <- function(df, cands, role = "", src = "") {
  if (is.null(df)) return(NA_character_)
  hit <- cands[cands %in% names(df)][1]
  ALIAS$rows[[length(ALIAS$rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(check.names = FALSE,
    来源表 = src, 语义角色 = role, 候选别名 = paste(cands, collapse = " / "),
    本次采用 = if (is.na(hit)) "⬜ 全不在列" else hit,
    裁决 = if (is.na(hit)) "该角色本次不可得，受其影响之输出一律点名缺席"
           else if (identical(hit, cands[1])) "首选名在列，直接采用"
           else "首选名不在列，降级采用次选名（已登记，不静默）",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  hit
}
```

```{r}
#| label: render-kit
# echo: false
## ══ 表题瘦身：「｜解释：…」一段收进 ⓘ 悬停浮层，正文只留主标题
cap_tip <- function(caption) {
  if (is.null(caption) || !nzchar(caption)) return(caption)
  k <- regexpr("｜解释：", caption, fixed = TRUE)
  if (k < 0) return(htmltools::HTML(caption))
  head0 <- substr(caption, 1, k - 1); tip0 <- substring(caption, k + 4)
  tip0 <- gsub("｜", "　▸ ", tip0, fixed = TRUE)
  tip0 <- gsub("[*`]", "", tip0)
  tip0 <- gsub("&", "&amp;", tip0, fixed = TRUE)
  tip0 <- gsub("<", "&lt;",  tip0, fixed = TRUE)
  tip0 <- gsub(">", "&gt;",  tip0, fixed = TRUE)
  tip0 <- gsub('"', "&quot;", tip0, fixed = TRUE)
  pos <- regexpr("：|——", head0)
  if (pos > 0) {
    cut <- attr(pos, "match.length")
    main <- substr(head0, 1, pos - 1); sub0 <- substring(head0, pos + cut)
  } else { main <- head0; sub0 <- "" }
  htmltools::HTML(paste0(
    '<span class="cap-main" style="display:block;font-size:1.02em;">', main,
    ' <span class="gl-tip" data-tip="解释：', tip0, '" style="font-weight:600">ⓘ</span></span>',
    if (nzchar(sub0)) paste0('<span class="cap-sub" style="display:block;font-size:.86em;',
      'font-weight:400;opacity:.78;margin-top:.15rem;">', sub0, '</span>') else ''))
}
md_cell <- function(v) {
  if (!is.character(v)) return(v)
  v <- gsub("\\*\\*(.+?)\\*\\*", "<b>\\1</b>", v, perl = TRUE)
  v <- gsub("`([^`]+)`", "<code>\\1</code>", v, perl = TRUE)
  v
}
## 静态表（短表专用）；长表一律走 dt_all()
kb <- function(x, caption = NULL, escape = TRUE, scroll = NULL) {
  d <- u8df(as.data.frame(x, check.names = FALSE))
  if (isFALSE(escape)) {
    for (j in seq_along(d)) d[[j]] <- md_cell(d[[j]])
    names(d) <- md_cell(names(d))
  }
  out <- knitr::kable(d, format = "html", escape = escape,
           caption = if (is.null(caption)) NULL else cap_tip(caption))
  if (is.null(scroll)) return(out)
  knitr::asis_output(paste0('<div class="tbl-scroll" style="max-height:', scroll, 'px;">',
    paste(as.character(out), collapse = "\n"), '</div>'))
}
## 行内数字挂悬停：阈值与结账结果一律以 tip() 包裹，鼠标停留即见其算法
tip <- function(txt, why) {
  why <- gsub("[*`]", "", why)
  why <- gsub("&", "&amp;", why, fixed = TRUE); why <- gsub("<", "&lt;", why, fixed = TRUE)
  why <- gsub(">", "&gt;", why, fixed = TRUE);  why <- gsub('"', "&quot;", why, fixed = TRUE)
  paste0('<span class="gl-tip" data-tip="', why, '">', txt, '</span>')
}
## 占位（铁律：缺数据必须点名文件、SQL 编号与受影响输出）
ph <- function(file, sql, hit) {
  kb(data.frame(check.names = FALSE, 状态 = "⬜ 待数据（非错误）", 所待文件 = file,
                `SQL 编号` = sql, 受影响输出 = hit,
                下一步 = sprintf("按运行手册以 %s 导出 %s 至 `%s/`，重渲染即自动出表",
                                 sql, file, if (is.null(DATA_DIR)) "数据库" else DATA_DIR)),
     caption = "本节以占位呈现（非错误）")
}
## ══ 互动桌表 dt_all()：行数与列数一律实测现算；行号取 data.table 印法（1: 2: … N:）
##    纪律：① 列一律不截断；② 行原则上不截断，超上限者写全量 CSV 并于副标题
##    明列省略行数与占比；③ 零行结果显式点名，绝不静默留白。
DT_MAX_ROWS <- 20000L
dt_all <- function(x, caption, note = "", order_by = NULL, desc = TRUE,
                   export = NULL, len = 12) {
  if (is.null(x) || !is.data.frame(x)) {
    return(kb(data.frame(状态 = "⬜ 本表未生成（料源缺席）", 说明 = note), caption = caption))
  }
  d <- u8df(as.data.frame(x, check.names = FALSE))
  n_all <- nrow(d); n_col <- ncol(d)
  if (n_all == 0L) {
    return(kb(data.frame(check.names = FALSE, 状态 = "⚠️ 零行结果（显式点名，非留白）",
      本表 = caption, 列数 = n_col,
      读法 = paste0("零行有两义：其一，判据在本窗口内确无命中；其二，料源列虽在而取值全空。",
                    "二者不可混为一谈——请对照上一节的『维度在位』表判读。", note)),
      caption = caption))
  }
  if (!is.null(order_by) && order_by %in% names(d))
    d <- d[order(numv(d[[order_by]]), decreasing = desc, na.last = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
  ## 全量落盘：显示可截，数据不可截
  exp_path <- NA_character_
  if (!is.null(export)) {
    exp_path <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(export, ".csv"))
    try(utils::write.csv(d, exp_path, row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8"), silent = TRUE)
  }
  n_show <- min(n_all, DT_MAX_ROWS); n_omit <- n_all - n_show
  ds <- d[seq_len(n_show), , drop = FALSE]
  idx <- data.frame(i = paste0(format(seq_len(n_show), trim = TRUE), ":"),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  nm0 <- names(ds)
  ds <- cbind(idx, ds); names(ds) <- c("#", nm0)   # 行号取 data.table 印法（1: 2: … N:）
  sub <- sprintf("总行数 %s ｜ 总列数 %d ｜ 省略 %s 行（%s）%s",
    amt(n_all), n_col, amt(n_omit), pct(n_omit / n_all, 2),
    if (is.na(exp_path)) "" else sprintf(" ｜ 全量已落盘：`%s`", exp_path))
  cap <- paste0(caption, "：", sub, if (nzchar(note)) paste0("｜解释：", note) else "")
  if (!isTRUE(HAS$DT)) return(kb(ds, caption = cap, escape = FALSE, scroll = 460))
  DT::datatable(ds, rownames = FALSE, escape = FALSE, caption = cap_tip(cap),
    extensions = "Buttons", width = "100%",
    options = list(pageLength = len, dom = "Bfrtip", buttons = c("copy", "csv"),
      scrollX = TRUE, scrollY = "460px", scrollCollapse = TRUE, autoWidth = FALSE,
      columnDefs = list(list(className = "rowidx", targets = 0),
                        list(className = "dt-head-left", targets = "_all"))),
    class = "display compact cell-border stripe")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: radar-kit
# echo: false
## ══ 版面三件（承精要版，一字不改）：按显示宽度折行 · 标题分主副 · JSON 出口
w_ <- function(x, width = 16, sep = "<br>") {
  vapply(as.character(x), function(t) {
    if (is.na(t) || !nzchar(t)) return(t)
    ch <- strsplit(t, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    wd <- ifelse(grepl("[\u2e80-\u9fff\uff00-\uffef\u3000-\u303f]", ch), 2L, 1L)
    out <- character(0); line <- ""; acc <- 0L
    for (k in seq_along(ch)) {
      if (acc + wd[k] > width && nzchar(line)) { out <- c(out, line); line <- ""; acc <- 0L }
      line <- paste0(line, ch[k]); acc <- acc + wd[k]
    }
    paste(c(out, line), collapse = sep)
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
EJ <- function(x) if (isTRUE(HAS$js))
  as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(x, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 6, na = "null")) else "null"
er_ttl <- function(title, width = 40) {
  pos <- regexpr("：|——", title)
  if (pos > 0) {
    cut <- attr(pos, "match.length")
    list(main = w_(substring(title, 1, pos - 1), width, "\n"),
         sub  = w_(substring(title, pos + cut), width + 10, "\n"))
  } else list(main = w_(title, width, "\n"), sub = "")
}
## 轴名装饰：单行、赏罚标记、缺名点名、待表标注
radar_txt <- function(labels, dirs = NULL, pend = NULL) {
  labels <- u8(labels)
  lb <- trimws(as.character(labels))
  bad <- which(!nzchar(lb) | is.na(lb))
  if (length(bad)) lb[bad] <- paste0("⚠维度名缺失#", bad)
  if (!is.null(dirs)) lb <- paste0(lb, " ", ifelse(dirs > 0, "赏", "罚"))
  if (!is.null(pend)) lb[pend] <- paste0(trimws(labels)[pend], " 待表零")
  lb
}
## ECharts 运行库：优先取 echarts4r 内附本地档（配合 embed-resources 内联，离线可看）
er_dep <- function() {
  d <- if (isTRUE(HAS$ec)) system.file("htmlwidgets", package = "echarts4r") else ""
  if (!nzchar(d) || !dir.exists(d)) return(NULL)
  h <- list.files(d, pattern = "^echarts\\.min\\.js$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(h)) h <- list.files(d, pattern = "^echarts\\.js$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(h)) return(NULL)
  f <- h[which.max(file.size(h))]
  message(sprintf("✅ ECharts 取自 echarts4r 本地档（%.1f MB）：%s",
                  file.size(f) / 1048576, basename(f)))
  htmltools::htmlDependency("echarts", "5", src = c(file = dirname(f)),
                            script = basename(f), all_files = FALSE)
}
er_id <- local({ i <- 0L; function(p) { i <<- i + 1L; sprintf("er-radar-%s-%d", p, i) } })
## ── ECharts 雷达图（承精要版 er_radar()，一字不改）─────────────────────
er_radar <- function(tag, title, labels, series, cols,
                     dirs = NULL, pend = NULL, note = "", height = 620) {
  txt <- radar_txt(labels, dirs, pend)
  n <- length(txt)
  message(sprintf("🧭 雷达轴名[%s] %d 条：%s", tag, n, paste(txt, collapse = " ｜ ")))
  J <- function(x) EJ(x)
  ind <- J(lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) list(name = txt[i], max = 100)))
  dat <- J(lapply(seq_along(series), function(i) {
    v <- as.numeric(series[[i]]); v[!is.finite(v)] <- 0
    list(name = names(series)[i], value = round(v, 2),
         lineStyle = list(color = cols[i], width = 2),
         itemStyle = list(color = cols[i]),
         areaStyle = list(color = cols[i], opacity = 0.13))
  }))
  id <- er_id(tag)
  paste0(
'<div class="er-radar" id="', id, '" style="width:100%;height:', height, 'px;"></div>\n',
'<script>\n',
'(function(){\n',
'  var IND = ', ind, ';\n',
'  var NMS = ', J(txt), ';\n',
'  var DAT = ', dat, ';\n',
'  var LEG = ', J(names(series)), ';\n',
'  var NOTE  = ', J(note), ';\n',
'  var OPT = {\n',
'    backgroundColor: "transparent",\n',
'    title: {text: ', EJ(er_ttl(title)$main), ', subtext: ', EJ(er_ttl(title)$sub), ',\n',
'            left: "center", top: 2, textAlign: "center",\n',
'            textStyle: {color: "', PAL$fg, '", fontSize: 14, fontWeight: "normal",\n',
'                        lineHeight: 20},\n',
'            subtextStyle: {color: "', PAL$fg, '", fontSize: 11, opacity: .78,\n',
'                           lineHeight: 17}},\n',
'    tooltip: {trigger: "item", confine: true,\n',
'      backgroundColor: "rgba(5,13,26,.96)", borderColor: "', PAL$ac, '",\n',
'      textStyle: {color: "', PAL$fg, '", fontSize: 12},\n',
'      formatter: function(p){\n',
'        var v = (p && p.value) ? p.value : [];\n',
'        var s = "<b>" + p.name + "</b><br/>";\n',
'        for (var i = 0; i < NMS.length; i++) {\n',
'          s += NMS[i] + "：" + Math.round(v[i] || 0) + " 分<br/>";\n',
'        }\n',
'        return s + "<span style=\\"opacity:.72\\">" + NOTE + "</span>";\n',
'      }},\n',
'    legend: {bottom: 2, itemGap: 16, data: LEG,\n',
'             textStyle: {color: "', PAL$fg, '", fontSize: 11}},\n',
'    radar: {center: ["50%", "55%"], radius: "56%", startAngle: 90,\n',
'      indicator: IND,\n',
'      axisName: {fontSize: 12, padding: [3, 5],\n',
'        formatter: function(nm){\n',
'          if (/待表零$/.test(nm)) { return "{pend|" + nm + "}"; }\n',
'          if (/罚$/.test(nm))     { return "{bad|"  + nm + "}"; }\n',
'          if (/赏$/.test(nm))     { return "{good|" + nm + "}"; }\n',
'          return "{neu|" + nm + "}";\n',
'        },\n',
'        rich: {good: {color: "', PAL$good, '", fontSize: 12},\n',
'               bad:  {color: "', PAL$bad,  '", fontSize: 12},\n',
'               pend: {color: "', PAL$warn, '", fontSize: 12},\n',
'               neu:  {color: "', PAL$fg,   '", fontSize: 12}}},\n',
'      splitLine: {lineStyle: {color: "#1e3a52"}},\n',
'      axisLine:  {lineStyle: {color: "#1e3a52"}},\n',
'      splitArea: {areaStyle: {color: ["rgba(10,25,45,.55)", "rgba(10,25,45,.30)"]}}},\n',
'    series: [{type: "radar", symbolSize: 4, data: DAT}]\n',
'  };\n',
'  var el = document.getElementById("', id, '"), chart = null;\n',
'  function boot(){\n',
'    if (!window.echarts || !el) { return false; }\n',
'    if (!(el.clientWidth > 1)) { return false; }\n',
'    if (!chart) { chart = echarts.init(el); chart.setOption(OPT); }\n',
'    return true;\n',
'  }\n',
'  function fit(){ if (chart) { chart.resize(); } else { boot(); } }\n',
'  if (!boot()) {\n',
'    var k = 0, iv = setInterval(function(){\n',
'      if (boot() || ++k > 200) {\n',
'        clearInterval(iv);\n',
'        if (!chart && el) {\n',
'          el.innerHTML = "<p style=\\"color:', PAL$bad, ';text-align:center;padding:2em\\">'
, '⬜ ECharts 未能载入（所待：R 包 echarts4r，或联网取用 CDN）；受影响输出：本雷达图</p>";\n',
'        }\n',
'      }\n',
'    }, 100);\n',
'  }\n',
'  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) { document.fonts.ready.then(fit); }\n',
'  window.addEventListener("resize", fit);\n',
'  if (window.ResizeObserver) { new ResizeObserver(fit).observe(el); }\n',
'  if (window.IntersectionObserver) {\n',
'    new IntersectionObserver(function(es){\n',
'      es.forEach(function(e){ if (e.isIntersecting) { fit(); } });\n',
'    }).observe(el);\n',
'  }\n',
'})();\n',
'</script>\n')
}
## 分位归一 0–100（四实体同一套，逐字同主方案 §17.2）
pq <- function(v) {
  v <- numv(v)
  r <- rank(v, na.last = "keep", ties.method = "average")
  100 * (r - 1) / max(sum(!is.na(v)) - 1, 1)
}
## 名单拼装：基础段 ＋ 领域段 ＋ 维度段；列名显式赋值（cbind 的 check.names 会改名）
bind_roster <- function(base, dom, dimn) {
  parts <- list(base); nms <- names(base)
  if (!is.null(dom) && ncol(dom)) {
    parts <- c(parts, list(round(dom, 1))); nms <- c(nms, paste0("领域｜", names(dom)))
  }
  if (!is.null(dimn) && ncol(dimn)) {
    parts <- c(parts, list(round(dimn, 1))); nms <- c(nms, paste0("维度｜", names(dimn)))
  }
  out <- do.call(cbind, parts); names(out) <- nms; out
}
```

# 一、读取关键数据表：读了哪几张 · 各有哪些维度 · 维度正名 {#sec-tables}

> 本章回答三问：**读了哪几张表**、**每张表有哪些维度**、**每一维的行业正名是什么**。
> 三问的答案一律**由本次渲染实测**：表清单来自装载器的返回，维度清单来自各件 CSV 的**实际表头**
> （不是记忆中的契约，也不是本报告的字典），正名与释义来自下方维度词典。
> **全文任意位置，把鼠标停在任一列名或任一维名上，即浮出该维的正名、语义、单位、粒度与用途。**

```{r}
#| label: glossary-inject
#| results: asis
# echo: false
## 把术语库注入页面：CSS 悬停浮层 ＋ 自动加注脚本（承主方案成法，一字不改其结构）
## 脚本全程走 DOM API（区间切分 ＋ setAttribute），结构上不可能被注入残片。
plain <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\$[^$]*\\$", "〔公式见正文〕", x)
  x <- gsub("\\*\\*([^*]+)\\*\\*", "\\1", x)
  x <- gsub("`([^`]+)`", "\\1", x)
  x <- gsub("[\r\n]+", " ", x)
  trimws(x)
}
esc_js <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\\\\\", x); x <- gsub('"', '\\\\"', x)
  x <- gsub("[\r\n\t]+", " ", x); gsub("</", "<\\\\/", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
js_str <- function(x) esc_js(plain(x))
gj <- paste0("{", paste(sprintf('"%s":"%s"',
  esc_js(GLOSSARY$术语),
  js_str(paste0("【", GLOSSARY$类别, "】", GLOSSARY$定义,
                "　▸ 本报告用途：", GLOSSARY$`在本报告的用途`))),
  collapse = ","), "}")
local({
  lone <- gsub("\\\\\\\\", "", gj)
  if (grepl("\\", lone, fixed = TRUE)) {
    message("⛔ 术语字典仍含落单反斜杠，浮层脚本降级为空字典——请核对维度词典中的转义")
    gj <<- "{}"
  }
})
JS_A <- '
<style>
.gl-tip{border-bottom:1px dotted var(--ac,#22d3ee);cursor:help;}
#gl-pop{position:fixed;z-index:2147483647;display:none;
  max-width:min(46rem,calc(100vw - 2rem));padding:.7rem .9rem;border-radius:8px;
  font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.6;font-weight:400;text-align:left;
  white-space:normal;word-break:break-word;overflow-wrap:anywhere;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(8,36,60,.985),rgba(11,61,58,.985));
  color:#e7fbf3;border:1px solid rgba(34,211,238,.55);
  box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.6);pointer-events:none;}
</style>
<script>
(function(){
  const GL = '
JS_B <- ';
  const terms = Object.keys(GL).sort((a,b)=>b.length-a.length);
  const SKIP = new Set(["PRE","SCRIPT","STYLE","TEXTAREA","A","OPTION","BUTTON","SUMMARY"]);
  function ready(fn){
    if(document.readyState === "loading"){ document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn); }
    else { fn(); }
    window.addEventListener("load", function(){ try{ fn(); }catch(e){} });
  }
  let GL_DONE = false;
  ready(function(){
    if(GL_DONE) return; GL_DONE = true;
    const scope = document.querySelector("main") || document.body;
    const secs = scope.querySelectorAll("section, div.callout, table");
    const targets = secs.length ? secs : [scope];
    const pop0 = document.getElementById("gl-pop") || document.createElement("div");
    pop0.id = "gl-pop";
    if(!pop0.parentNode) document.body.appendChild(pop0);
    targets.forEach(function(sec){
      try{
      const walker = document.createTreeWalker(sec, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
        acceptNode: function(n){
          let p = n.parentNode;
          while(p && p !== sec){ if(SKIP.has(p.tagName) || (p.classList &&
            p.classList.contains("gl-tip"))) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT; p = p.parentNode; }
          return n.nodeValue.trim() ? NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT : NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
        }});
      const nodes = []; while(walker.nextNode()) nodes.push(walker.currentNode);
      nodes.forEach(function(node){
        const txt = node.nodeValue;
        const hits = [];
        terms.forEach(function(t){
          let i = txt.indexOf(t);
          while(i >= 0){ hits.push({t: t, i: i}); i = txt.indexOf(t, i + t.length); }
        });
        if(!hits.length) return;
        hits.sort(function(a,b){ return a.i - b.i || b.t.length - a.t.length; });
        const picked = []; let last = -1;
        hits.forEach(function(h){ if(h.i >= last){ picked.push(h); last = h.i + h.t.length; } });
        if(!picked.length) return;
        const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
        let pos = 0;
        picked.forEach(function(h){
          if(h.i > pos) frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(txt.slice(pos, h.i)));
          const sp = document.createElement("span");
          sp.className = "gl-tip";
          sp.setAttribute("data-tip", GL[h.t]);
          sp.textContent = h.t;
          frag.appendChild(sp);
          pos = h.i + h.t.length;
        });
        if(pos < txt.length) frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(txt.slice(pos)));
        if(node.parentNode) node.parentNode.replaceChild(frag, node);
      });
      }catch(e){ }
    });
    const pop = pop0;
    function place(t){
      pop.textContent = t.getAttribute("data-tip") || "";
      pop.style.display = "block";
      pop.style.left = "0px"; pop.style.top = "0px";
      const r = t.getBoundingClientRect();
      const w = pop.offsetWidth, h = pop.offsetHeight, M = 10;
      let x = r.left, y = r.bottom + 6;
      if(x + w > window.innerWidth - M) x = window.innerWidth - w - M;
      if(x < M) x = M;
      if(y + h > window.innerHeight - M) y = r.top - h - 6;
      if(y < M) y = M;
      pop.style.left = x + "px"; pop.style.top = y + "px";
    }
    document.body.addEventListener("mouseover", function(ev){
      const t = ev.target;
      if(t && t.classList && t.classList.contains("gl-tip")) place(t);
    }, true);
    document.body.addEventListener("mouseout", function(ev){
      const t = ev.target;
      if(t && t.classList && t.classList.contains("gl-tip")) pop.style.display = "none";
    }, true);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", function(){ pop.style.display = "none"; }, true);
  });
})();
</script>
'
FENCE <- strrep("`", 3L)
cat("\n", FENCE, "{=html}\n", JS_A, gj, JS_B, "\n", FENCE, "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r}
#| label: load-core
## ══ 关键数据表装载。契约锁 must= 挂在装载处：口径变更即缺列、缺列即当场不装载，
##    使「新文字配旧数字」的静默语义漂移在装载处即显形，不拖到深处哑错。
B01  <- read_any("B01_bt_panel",
                 must = c("member_id","bet_date","validbet","net_pnl","game_pnl"))
K01  <- read_any("K01_risk_feature_matrix",
                 must = c("member_id","validbet","hedge_rate","side_entropy","n_days"))
SEED <- read_any("K01b_seed_manual")
C06  <- read_any("C06_hedge_pairs")
R01  <- read_any("R01_late_shoe", must = c("late_def","uid","late_share"))
R02  <- read_any("R02_same_table")
R03  <- read_any("R03_player_dealer")
R03b <- read_any("R03b_player_dealer_daily",
                 select = c("bet_date","uid","dealer_id","stake_amount","profit_amount",
                            "net_pnl","win_rate","n_related_orders","n_rounds_eff",
                            "z_score","eligibility_status"))
IPL  <- read_any("I_ip_player", must = c("member_id","bet_ip"))
IPA  <- read_any("I_ip_agg")
C01  <- read_any("C01_ip_chain")
C08s <- read_any("C08_subnet_sparse")
TAIL <- read_any("S_player_tail")
T03  <- read_any("T03_arbitrage")
E02  <- read_any("E02_segment_econ")
S01  <- read_any("S01_player_score")
S02  <- read_any("S02_dealer_score")
S03  <- read_any("S03_agent_score")
PPM  <- read_any("P_player_month")
gc2(); mem("全表装载毕")

## ══ 资格分层：装载即分层，其后一律取合格层（承主方案与精要版同一判据）
##    判据与 SQL §R03 之 is_sentinel_dealer 逐字同义：TRIM(eid) IN ('-1','0')。
##    ★ 空字符串不入哨兵——`""` 与 NA 是两种状态，混为一谈即制造口径分裂。
SENTINEL_IDS <- c("-1", "0")
is_sentinel  <- function(v) { s <- trimws(as.character(v)); !is.na(s) & s %in% SENTINEL_IDS }
QUAL <- NULL
for (nm in c("R03","R03b")) {
  x <- get(nm)
  if (is.null(x) || !("dealer_id" %in% names(x))) next
  x$dealer_id <- ifelse(is.na(x$dealer_id), NA_character_, trimws(as.character(x$dealer_id)))
  sent <- is_sentinel(x$dealer_id)
  keep <- !sent
  n_sql <- if ("eligibility_status" %in% names(x))
    sum(trimws(as.character(x$eligibility_status)) == "SENTINEL_DEALER", na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_
  if ("eligibility_status" %in% names(x))
    keep <- keep & (trimws(as.character(x$eligibility_status)) %in% "ELIGIBLE")
  QUAL[[nm]] <- list(表 = nm, n_full = nrow(x), n_sent = sum(sent), n_keep = sum(keep),
                     d_full = length(unique(x$dealer_id)),
                     d_keep = length(unique(x$dealer_id[keep])),
                     n_sql_sent = n_sql, has_elig = "eligibility_status" %in% names(x),
                     n_na = sum(is.na(x$dealer_id)))
  assign(nm, x[keep, , drop = FALSE])
  rm(x, sent, keep); gc2()
}
WIN <- if (!is.null(B01)) list(a = min(B01$bet_date, na.rm = TRUE),
                               b = max(B01$bet_date, na.rm = TRUE),
                               n = length(unique(B01$bet_date))) else NULL
```

```{r}
 c("I_ip_player","C-00","玩家×IP×三级代理线","异常 IP 族、代理侧归因主键 lv3"),
 c("I_ip_agg","C-02","IP 汇总（有效关联会员数与盈利口径）","异常 IP 之聚集度判据"),
 c("C01_ip_chain","C-01","IP 单链会员密度","IP 结构风险维、异常 IP 主判据"),
 c("C08_subnet_sparse","AX-A5","/24 稀疏网段名单","异常 IP 的**条件化闸**：滤除 CGNAT 公共出口"),
 c("S_player_tail","D-06","玩家尾段十一项指标","尾秒族全维度与其检验"),
 c("T03_arbitrage","§T03","打水型明细（退水与净额）","退水漏损核算"),
 c("E02_segment_econ","§E02c","客户分层经济账","分层对照（**只可取比率**）"),
 c("S01_player_score","S-01ex","玩家能力值导出件","在包即直读，缺席即由包内表复算"),
 c("S02_dealer_score","S-02ex","荷官能力值导出件","同上"),
 c("S03_agent_score","S-03ex","代理能力值导出件","同上"),
 c("P_player_month","P-01","会员×月面板","下线留存、新增会员质量"))
OBJ <- list(B01=B01, K01=K01, SEED=SEED, C06=C06, R01=R01, R02=R02, R03=R03, R03b=R03b,
            IPL=IPL, IPA=IPA, C01=C01, C08s=C08s, TAIL=TAIL, T03=T03, E02=E02,
            S01=S01, S02=S02, S03=S03, PPM=PPM)
KEYS <- c("B01","K01","SEED","C06","R01","R02","R03","R03b","IPL","IPA","C01","C08s",
          "TAIL","T03","E02","S01","S02","S03","PPM")
INV <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(REG), function(i) {
  o <- OBJ[[KEYS[i]]]
  data.frame(check.names = FALSE,
    数据表 = REG[[i]][1], `SQL 编号` = REG[[i]][2], 行业正名 = REG[[i]][3],
    状态 = if (is.null(o)) "⬜ 未就位" else "🟢 已装载",
    行数 = if (is.null(o)) "—" else amt(nrow(o)),
    读入列数 = if (is.null(o)) "—" else as.character(ncol(o)),
    表头全列数 = if (is.null(o)) "—" else as.character(length(attr(o, "全列名") %||% names(o))),
    编码 = if (is.null(o)) "—" else (attr(o, "编码") %||% "—"),
    在本报告的用途 = REG[[i]][4],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
dt_all(INV, caption = "关键数据表清单",
  note = paste0("状态、行列数与编码皆由本次渲染实测；「读入列数 < 表头全列数」者系为省内存",
                "只读必要列，其**全列名**仍另路留存（Schema 证据与分析载荷解耦），",
                "故下一节的全维度总表不受读入范围影响"),
  export = "01_数据表清单", len = 20)
```

## 全维度总表：所有数据表的**所有维度**逐维呈现 {#sec-alldims}

> 下表的每一行是**一个维度**（＝一张表的一列）。列清单取自各件 CSV 的**实际表头**，
> 不取本报告的字典——**字典缺了什么，本表会点名，而不是掩盖**。
> 表内任一列名或正名，鼠标停留即出释义。

```{r}
#| label: all-dims
# echo: false
ALLDIM <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(KEYS), function(i) {
  o <- OBJ[[KEYS[i]]]; tb <- REG[[i]][1]
  if (is.null(o)) return(NULL)
  cols <- attr(o, "全列名") %||% names(o)
  cols <- u8(cols)
  if (!length(cols)) return(NULL)
  d1 <- DIMDICT[DIMDICT$表 == tb, , drop = FALSE]
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cols), function(j) {
    cc <- cols[j]
    r <- d1[d1$列 == cc, , drop = FALSE]
    if (!nrow(r)) r <- DIM_GLOBAL[DIM_GLOBAL$列 == cc, , drop = FALSE]
    hit <- nrow(r) > 0
    inmem <- cc %in% names(o)
    v <- if (inmem) o[[cc]] else NULL
    nv <- if (inmem) numv(v) else NA_real_
    isnum <- inmem && sum(is.finite(nv)) > 0.6 * length(nv)
    data.frame(check.names = FALSE,
      数据表 = tb, 列序 = j, 列名 = cc,
      行业正名 = if (hit) r$正名[1] else "⚠️ 词典未覆盖",
      语义 = if (hit) r$语义[1] else "⚠️ 本报告字典未登记此列——须补登记后方可用于计算",
      单位 = if (hit) r$单位[1] else "—",
      粒度 = if (hit) r$粒度[1] else "—",
      方向 = if (hit) r$方向[1] else "—",
      本次读入 = if (inmem) "✅ 已读入" else "◻️ 未读入（仅留表头证据）",
      非空率 = if (inmem) pct(mean(!is.na(v)), 1) else "—",
      不同值数 = if (inmem) amt(length(unique(v))) else "—",
      实测极值 = if (isnum) paste0(amt2(min(nv, na.rm = TRUE)), " ~ ", amt2(max(nv, na.rm = TRUE)))
                 else if (inmem) paste0("文本／类别（示例：",
                        paste(utils::head(unique(as.character(v[!is.na(v)])), 3), collapse = "、"), "）")
                 else "—",
      在本报告的用途 = if (hit) r$用途[1] else "—",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}))
if (is.null(ALLDIM)) {
  ph("数据库/*.csv（关键数据表）", "SQL 总包 §B01/§K01/§R01/§R02/§R03/C-00 等",
     "全维度总表与其后一切计算")
} else {
  dt_all(ALLDIM, caption = "全维度总表：逐表逐维（列清单取自实际表头）",
    note = paste0("非空率、不同值数与实测极值皆由本次渲染现算；「⚠️ 词典未覆盖」者即本报告",
                  "维度词典尚未登记之列——**登记之前不得用于任何计算**，此为口径纪律，",
                  "不是显示问题"),
    export = "03_全维度总表", len = 15)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: dim-cover
# echo: false
GAPDIM <- if (is.null(ALLDIM)) NULL else
  ALLDIM[ALLDIM$行业正名 == "⚠️ 词典未覆盖", c("数据表","列名","本次读入","非空率","实测极值")]
if (is.null(ALLDIM)) {
  kb(data.frame(状态 = "⬜ 全维度总表未生成，覆盖自检无从进行"), caption = "维度词典覆盖自检")
} else {

    实测维度总数 = amt(nrow(ALLDIM)),

    词典未覆盖 = amt(nrow(GAPDIM)),

    caption = "维度词典覆盖自检（渲染现算）", escape = FALSE)
}
```

# 二、能力值追溯矩阵：每一维，从领域一路追到料源列 {#sec-trace}

> 追溯矩阵回答的不是「这一维得几分」，而是**「这一分是从哪来的」**：
> 它属哪个统一领域、是赏是罚、原始量怎么算、料源是哪张表哪几列、
> **这几列本次在不在位**、其证据等级到哪一级。
> 凡「料源不在位」者，其维在雷达上一律**以待表零示之并于轴名标注**，绝不合成数值顶替。

## 统一领域本体 D01–D12：领域是统一的，实体不是 {#sec-domain}

```{r}
#| label: domain-ontology
# echo: false
DOMAIN <- do.call(rbind, lapply(list(
 c("D01","获客","谁把人带进来，且带进来的是客人而非人头","新增会员首月净贡献"),
 c("D02","激活","谁把注册者带到首投","首投转化率（**本平台无表，空着即是信息**）"),
 c("D03","充值","谁带来真金白银的入金","充值额（**待证，不得以投注额顶替**）"),
 c("D04","活跃","谁在持续地玩、玩得分散还是专攻","出勤天数、产品结构熵、客群广度"),
 c("D05","留存","谁还在，且下个月还在","次月留存、生命周期阶段"),
 c("D06","收入","谁带来营业额（洗码量）","有效投注（**四实体皆有，故是唯一可横比的坐标**）"),
 c("D07","盈利","营业额里留下多少","游戏输赢贡献、退水消耗比"),
 c("D08","风险","谁在做不该做的事","对打、索提诺、人工标记、關聯異常"),
 c("D09","效率","单位投入产出多少","当值时长、节奏稳定度"),
 c("D10","质量","做得对不对、可不可复核","判定详尽度（**本报告三实体皆空**）"),
 c("D11","网络","谁和谁连在一起","IP 结构风险、单链密度、特定玩家复现率"),
 c("D12","合规","流程是否合规","（**现有维度一个都没落到，空白如实呈现**）")
), function(v) data.frame(check.names = FALSE, 领域ID = v[1], 领域名 = v[2],
     所答之问 = v[3], 可观测结局 = v[4], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
kb(DOMAIN, caption = paste0("统一领域本体 D01–D12（承主方案）",
   "｜解释：领域统一而实体不统一——某实体在某领域无维，是「理论上存在而当前数据不足」，",
   "**绝不可当作 0**；空着即是信息"), escape = FALSE)
```

::: {.callout-important}
## 三条不可退让的读法

**其一，`○` 不是 0。** 某实体在某领域没有维度，意思是「此处无证据」，
不是「此处得零分」。雷达上以**待表零**标注者同理——**那是坐标轴的占位，不是分数**。

**其二，只有 D06 收入可作跨实体横比。** 三实体皆有该领域之维（玩家流水贡献、
荷官在桌洗码量、代理真实流水）；其余领域至少缺一实体，横比即是拿有证据者与无证据者相较。

**其三，本报告的领域分是「同向化」之后的呈现量。** 领域内若混有赏罚两向之维，
一律先把罚侧取反（$\tilde v = 100 - v$）再平均，使雷达上**越外圈越好**。
此为**呈现变换**；综合分仍照主方案 §17.2 原式 $\text{赏}-\text{罚}$ 计，**一字未改**。
:::

```{r}
 c("风控专员","D09","登记跨度","1","首末登记时间跨度","S04_analyst_score","—","E1","同上"),
 c("风控专员","D10","理由空白率","-1","理由空白数 ÷ 标注产量","S04_analyst_score","—","E1","同上"),
 c("风控专员","D09","标注停滞度","-1","距全体最近登记日天数 ÷ 该员登记跨度","S04_analyst_score","—","E1","同上")
), function(v) data.frame(check.names = FALSE, 实体 = v[1], 领域ID = v[2], 维度 = v[3],
     赏罚 = as.numeric(v[4]), 原始量表达式 = v[5], 料源表 = v[6], 料源列 = v[7],
     证据等级 = v[8], 备注 = v[9], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
CAPDICT <- u8df(CAPDICT)
CAPDICT$领域名 <- DOMAIN$领域名[match(CAPDICT$领域ID, DOMAIN$领域ID)]
CAPDICT$方向 <- ifelse(CAPDICT$赏罚 > 0, "赏（越大越好）", "罚（越大越糟）")

## ── 料源在位判定：逐维核对其所需之表与列，本次是否俱在 ──────────────────
TBL2OBJ <- setNames(KEYS, vapply(REG, function(v) v[1], ""))
avail_of <- function(tbls, cols) {
  tv <- trimws(strsplit(tbls, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
  cv <- trimws(strsplit(cols, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]); cv <- cv[cv != "—"]
  ## 表判定：所需之表有一不在即判缺表
  getk <- function(t) if (t %in% names(TBL2OBJ)) TBL2OBJ[[t]] else NA_character_
  miss_t <- tv[vapply(tv, function(t) {
    k <- getk(t); is.na(k) || is.null(OBJ[[k]])
  }, TRUE)]
  ## 列判定：某列只要在**任一所需表**中出现即算在位（跨表取数之常态）
  have_all <- unique(unlist(lapply(tv, function(t) {
    k <- getk(t); o <- if (is.na(k)) NULL else OBJ[[k]]
    if (is.null(o)) character(0) else unique(c(names(o), attr(o, "全列名") %||% character(0)))
  })))
  miss_c <- setdiff(cv, have_all)
  list(miss_t = unique(miss_t), miss_c = miss_c,
       ok = length(miss_t) == 0 && length(miss_c) == 0)
}
TRACE <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(CAPDICT)), function(i) {
  r <- CAPDICT[i, ]
  if (r$实体 == "风控专员") {
    st <- "◻️ 本报告不计算（留位存血统）"; note <- "先生本次点名玩家／荷官／代理三实体"
  } else {
    a <- avail_of(r$料源表, r$料源列)
    st <- if (a$ok) "🟢 料源在位" else
          if (length(a$miss_t)) paste0("⬜ 缺表：", paste(a$miss_t, collapse = "、")) else
          paste0("🟠 缺列：", paste(a$miss_c, collapse = "、"))
    note <- if (a$ok) "本次渲染可现算" else "该维在雷达上以**待表零**示之，并于轴名标注；绝不合成数值"
  }
  data.frame(check.names = FALSE,
    实体 = r$实体, 领域 = paste0(r$领域ID, " ", r$领域名), 维度 = r$维度,
    赏罚方向 = r$方向, 原始量表达式 = r$原始量表达式,
    料源表 = gsub(";", " ＋ ", r$料源表), 料源列 = gsub(";", "、", r$料源列),
    本次料源状态 = st, 证据等级 = r$证据等级, 备注 = paste0(r$备注, "；", note),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
```

```{r}
#| label: econ-engine
# echo: false
## ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
##  经济核算引擎（三实体共用一套，口径只此一处）
##  营业额口径 ＝ 有效投注（洗码量）validbet
##  盈亏口径   ＝ GGR ＝ −Σ game_pnl（剔退水）
##                NGR₂ ＝ −Σ net_pnl（扣退水后；本平台只能算到第三层，此为第二层）
##                退水支出 ＝ GGR − NGR₂ ＝ Σ(net_pnl − game_pnl)
##  ★ 「会计差额」＝（全体 NGR₂ 率 − 该群体 NGR₂ 率）× 该群体洗码量
##    读法：**若该群体表现同于全体，平台本可多得多少**。这是情景基准下的差额，
##    证据等级 E3，**不是因果损失**——真实增减益须随机对照方能结账。
## ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
econ_ids <- function(ids, lab = "") {
  if (is.null(B01) || is.null(ids) || !length(ids)) return(NULL)
  key <- as.character(B01$member_id)
  sel <- key %in% as.character(ids)
  if (!any(sel)) return(list(lab = lab, n = 0L, vb = 0, ggr = 0, ngr = 0, reb = 0))
  vb  <- sum(numv(B01$validbet[sel]),  na.rm = TRUE)
  gp  <- sum(numv(B01$game_pnl[sel]),  na.rm = TRUE)
  np  <- sum(numv(B01$net_pnl[sel]),   na.rm = TRUE)
  list(lab = lab, n = length(unique(key[sel])), vb = vb,
       ggr = -gp, ngr = -np, reb = np - gp)
}
ECON_ALL <- econ_ids(if (is.null(B01)) NULL else unique(B01$member_id), "全体")
rate_ngr_all <- if (is.null(ECON_ALL) || ECON_ALL$vb <= 0) NA_real_ else ECON_ALL$ngr / ECON_ALL$vb
rate_ggr_all <- if (is.null(ECON_ALL) || ECON_ALL$vb <= 0) NA_real_ else ECON_ALL$ggr / ECON_ALL$vb
econ_row <- function(e, 族, 口径 = "会员直接口径") {
  if (is.null(e)) return(NULL)
  r_ngr <- if (e$vb > 0) e$ngr / e$vb else NA_real_
  r_ggr <- if (e$vb > 0) e$ggr / e$vb else NA_real_
  gapv  <- if (is.finite(rate_ngr_all) && e$vb > 0) (rate_ngr_all - r_ngr) * e$vb else NA_real_
  data.frame(check.names = FALSE,
    风险族 = 族, 归因口径 = 口径, 命中实体数 = amt(e$n),
    `营业额（洗码量）` = amt(e$vb),
    `占全体营业额` = if (!is.null(ECON_ALL) && ECON_ALL$vb > 0) pct(e$vb / ECON_ALL$vb, 3) else "—",
    `GGR（毛利）` = amt(e$ggr), `GGR 率` = pct(r_ggr, 3),
    `NGR₂（扣退水）` = amt(e$ngr), `NGR₂ 率` = pct(r_ngr, 3),
    `退水支出` = amt(e$reb),
    `全体 NGR₂ 率` = pct(rate_ngr_all, 3),
    `会计差额（若同于全体，平台本可多得）` = amt(gapv),
    `差额占全体 NGR₂` = if (!is.null(ECON_ALL) && ECON_ALL$ngr != 0) pct(gapv / ECON_ALL$ngr, 3) else "—",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
## 样本量下限：由 Wilson 区间宽度收敛至 0.15 反解，**不由人拍**
wilson_w <- function(n, p = 0.5, z = 1.959964) {
  d <- 1 + z^2 / n
  2 * (z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2)) / d)
}
n_min_wilson <- function(target = 0.15, p = 0.5) {
  n <- 5L; while (n < 20000L && wilson_w(n, p) > target) n <- n + 1L; n
}
N_MIN <- n_min_wilson(0.15, 0.5)
qthr <- function(v, p) { v <- numv(v); v <- v[is.finite(v)]
  if (!length(v)) return(NA_real_); as.numeric(stats::quantile(v, p, na.rm = TRUE)) }
```

```{r}
#| label: fam-engine
# echo: false
## ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
##  四族风险判定引擎：异常 IP · 尾秒下注 · 对打 · 同桌率
##  纪律三条：
##   ① **阈值一律由本窗口分布现算**（分位或反解），硬编码阈值一概不用；
##   ② 每族皆须过**样本量门槛**——局数不足者其比率不可信，一律不进名单；
##   ③ 名单是**调查候选**，不是定罪；荷官与代理侧一律标注为**归因口径**。
## ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
FAM <- list(); CRIT <- list()
add_crit <- function(族, 指标, 口径, 阈值, 阈值来源, 命中) {
  CRIT[[length(CRIT) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(check.names = FALSE,
    风险族 = 族, 判定指标 = 指标, 计算口径 = 口径,
    本次阈值 = 阈值, 阈值来源 = 阈值来源, 命中数 = 命中, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

## ── 一族：异常 IP ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (!is.null(IPL) && "member_id" %in% names(IPL) && "bet_ip" %in% names(IPL)) {
  ip <- IPL
  for (cc in c("n_orders_ip","ip_order_share","stake_ip","net_pnl_ip","game_pnl_ip","n_rounds_ip"))
    if (cc %in% names(ip)) ip[[cc]] <- numv(ip[[cc]]) else ip[[cc]] <- NA_real_
  if (!is.null(C01) && all(c("bet_ip","member_per_chain") %in% names(C01))) {
    c1 <- data.frame(bet_ip = C01$bet_ip, member_per_chain = numv(C01$member_per_chain))
    ip <- merge(ip, c1, by = "bet_ip", all.x = TRUE)
  } else ip$member_per_chain <- NA_real_
  if (!is.null(IPA) && "bet_ip" %in% names(IPA) && "n_member_eff" %in% names(IPA)) {
    ia <- data.frame(bet_ip = IPA$bet_ip, n_member_eff = numv(IPA$n_member_eff))
    ip <- merge(ip, ia, by = "bet_ip", all.x = TRUE)
  } else ip$n_member_eff <- NA_real_
  ## 条件化闸：稀疏网段命中方为可疑；无此件即**不得称已条件化**
  sparse_ok <- !is.null(C08s)
  ip$稀疏段命中 <- NA
  if (sparse_ok) {
    sc <- col1(C08s, c("subnet","bet_ip","ip_prefix","net24"), "稀疏网段键", "C08_subnet_sparse")
    if (!is.na(sc)) {
      sub24 <- function(x) sub("^((\\d+\\.){3}).*$", "\\1", as.character(x))
      ip$稀疏段命中 <- sub24(ip$bet_ip) %in% sub24(C08s[[sc]]) | ip$bet_ip %in% C08s[[sc]]
    } else sparse_ok <- FALSE
  }
  t_chain <- qthr(unique(ip[, c("bet_ip","member_per_chain")])$member_per_chain, .99)
  t_share <- qthr(ip$ip_order_share, .90)
  hit <- rep(TRUE, nrow(ip))
  hit <- hit & (is.finite(ip$member_per_chain) & ip$member_per_chain >= t_chain)
  hit <- hit & (is.finite(ip$ip_order_share)   & ip$ip_order_share   >= t_share)
  hit <- hit & (is.finite(ip$n_orders_ip)      & ip$n_orders_ip      >= N_MIN)
  if (sparse_ok) hit <- hit & (ip$稀疏段命中 %in% TRUE)
  hit[is.na(hit)] <- FALSE
  IPHIT <- ip[hit, , drop = FALSE]
  add_crit("异常 IP", "单链会员密度 member_per_chain", "该会员所踩 IP 的一线塞号数",
           amt2(t_chain), "本窗口 IP 分布 P99（现算）", amt(sum(hit)))
  add_crit("异常 IP", "该 IP 注单占比 ip_order_share", "该 IP 注单 ÷ 该会员全部注单",
           amt2(t_share), "本窗口分布 P90（现算）", "同上（与式合取）")
  add_crit("异常 IP", "该 IP 下注单数 n_orders_ip", "样本量门槛",
           amt(N_MIN), sprintf("Wilson 区间宽度收敛至 0.15 反解（p=0.5，%d 局）", N_MIN), "同上（与式合取）")
  add_crit("异常 IP", "稀疏网段条件化", "滤除 CGNAT／公共出口，否则榜首为电信基础设施",
           if (sparse_ok) "已启用（C08 在位）" else "⚠️ 未启用（C08 缺席）",
           if (sparse_ok) "AX-A5 /24 稀疏段名单" else "**本次名单未条件化，含公共出口噪声风险**",
           if (sparse_ok) "已计入" else "—")
  FAM[["异常 IP"]] <- list(tbl = IPHIT, ids = unique(IPHIT$member_id),
    key = "member_id", export = "10_玩家_异常IP名录")
} else {
  FAM[["异常 IP"]] <- list(tbl = NULL, ids = character(0), key = "member_id",
    export = "10_玩家_异常IP名录")
  add_crit("异常 IP", "—", "料源缺席", "—", "所待：I_ip_player（C-00）＋ C01_ip_chain（C-01）", "—")
}

## ── 二族：尾秒下注（**画像口径**：E1 已裁定其信息优势未能证实）───────────
TL <- NULL
if (!is.null(TAIL) && "member_id" %in% names(TAIL)) {
  TL <- TAIL; TL$uid <- TL$member_id; TLsrc <- "S_player_tail（D-06）"
} else if (!is.null(R01) && "uid" %in% names(R01)) {
  TL <- R01; TLsrc <- "R01_late_shoe（§R01，靴末段口径）"
}
if (!is.null(TL)) {
  share_c <- col1(TL, c("tail_share","late_share"), "尾段注单占比", TLsrc)
  nrd_c   <- col1(TL, c("n_rounds_tail","n_orders_late"), "尾段样本量", TLsrc)
  TL$.share <- if (is.na(share_c)) NA_real_ else numv(TL[[share_c]])
  TL$.n     <- if (is.na(nrd_c))   NA_real_ else numv(TL[[nrd_c]])
  t_share2 <- qthr(TL$.share, .99)
  hit2 <- is.finite(TL$.share) & TL$.share >= t_share2 & is.finite(TL$.n) & TL$.n >= N_MIN
  hit2[is.na(hit2)] <- FALSE
  TLHIT <- TL[hit2, , drop = FALSE]
  add_crit("尾秒下注（画像）", if (is.na(share_c)) "—" else share_c, "尾段注单 ÷ 全部注单",
           amt2(t_share2), "本窗口分布 P99（现算）", amt(sum(hit2)))
  add_crit("尾秒下注（画像）", if (is.na(nrd_c)) "—" else nrd_c, "样本量门槛",
           amt(N_MIN), "Wilson 区间宽度 0.15 反解", "同上（与式合取）")
  add_crit("尾秒下注（画像）", "经济量是否计入合计", "E1 五重检验裁定其优势未能证实",
           "**不计入**", "主方案 §E1 尾段裁定（含 Simpson 分解与符号检验）", "—")
  FAM[["尾秒下注（画像）"]] <- list(tbl = TLHIT, ids = unique(TLHIT$uid),
    key = "uid", export = "11_玩家_尾秒下注画像名录", 画像 = TRUE)
} else {
  FAM[["尾秒下注（画像）"]] <- list(tbl = NULL, ids = character(0), key = "uid",
    export = "11_玩家_尾秒下注画像名录", 画像 = TRUE)
  add_crit("尾秒下注（画像）", "—", "料源缺席", "—", "所待：S_player_tail（D-06）或 R01_late_shoe（§R01）", "—")
}

## ── 三族：对打 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (!is.null(C06) && all(c("m_a","m_b") %in% names(C06))) {
  cp <- C06
  or_c <- col1(cp, c("opposite_rate"), "反向下注率", "C06_hedge_pairs")
  ns_c <- col1(cp, c("n_same_round","n_same_orders"), "同局次数", "C06_hedge_pairs")
  cp$.or <- if (is.na(or_c)) NA_real_ else numv(cp[[or_c]])
  cp$.ns <- if (is.na(ns_c)) NA_real_ else numv(cp[[ns_c]])
  t_or <- if (any(cp$.or >= 1, na.rm = TRUE)) 1 else qthr(cp$.or, .99)
  ns_floor <- suppressWarnings(min(N_MIN, max(cp$.ns, na.rm = TRUE)))
  hit3 <- is.finite(cp$.or) & cp$.or >= t_or &
          (!is.finite(cp$.ns) | cp$.ns >= ns_floor)
  hit3[is.na(hit3)] <- FALSE
  CPHIT <- cp[hit3, , drop = FALSE]
  ids3 <- unique(c(as.character(CPHIT$m_a), as.character(CPHIT$m_b)))
  add_crit("对打", if (is.na(or_c)) "—" else or_c, "同局一庄一闲（完全对冲）之占比",
           amt2(t_or), if (t_or >= 1) "完全反向（＝1）实测存在，故取其为阈"
                       else "本窗口分布 P99（现算，无完全反向对）", amt(nrow(CPHIT)))
  add_crit("对打", if (is.na(ns_c)) "—" else ns_c, "同局次数（样本量门槛）",
           if (is.na(ns_c)) "⚠️ 该列缺席，本族未设样本量门槛" else amt(ns_floor),
           "Wilson 反解与实测上限取小者，避免门槛高过全体最大值而名单恒空", "—")
  FAM[["对打"]] <- list(tbl = CPHIT, ids = ids3, key = "m_a",
    export = "12_玩家_对打名录", 对表 = TRUE)
} else {
  FAM[["对打"]] <- list(tbl = NULL, ids = character(0), key = "m_a",
    export = "12_玩家_对打名录", 对表 = TRUE)
  add_crit("对打", "—", "料源缺席", "—", "所待：C06_hedge_pairs（§C06fix）", "—")
}

## ── 四族：同桌率（**须活跃度校正**：裸值会被高频客污染）──────────────────
if (!is.null(R02) && all(c("uid1","uid2") %in% names(R02))) {
  st <- R02
  sr_c <- col1(st, c("same_rate"), "裸同桌率", "R02_same_table")
  so_c <- col1(st, c("n_same_orders","n_same_round"), "同桌注单数", "R02_same_table")
  st$.sr <- if (is.na(sr_c)) NA_real_ else numv(st[[sr_c]])
  st$.so <- if (is.na(so_c)) NA_real_ else numv(st[[so_c]])
  med_sr <- stats::median(st$.sr, na.rm = TRUE)
  st$相对倍数 <- if (is.finite(med_sr) && med_sr > 0) st$.sr / med_sr else NA_real_
  t_sr <- qthr(st$.sr, .99)
  t_so <- min(N_MIN, suppressWarnings(max(st$.so, na.rm = TRUE)))
  hit4 <- is.finite(st$.sr) & st$.sr >= t_sr &
          (!is.finite(st$.so) | st$.so >= t_so)
  hit4[is.na(hit4)] <- FALSE
  STHIT <- st[hit4, , drop = FALSE]
  ids4 <- unique(c(as.character(STHIT$uid1), as.character(STHIT$uid2)))
  add_crit("同桌率", if (is.na(sr_c)) "—" else sr_c, "同桌同局注单 ÷ 该对较少一方注单",
           amt2(t_sr), "本窗口分布 P99（现算）", amt(nrow(STHIT)))
  add_crit("同桌率", "相对倍数（活跃度校正代理量）", "裸同桌率 ÷ 全体中位数",
           amt2(if (is.finite(med_sr) && med_sr > 0) t_sr / med_sr else NA_real_),
           paste0("**校正未完备**：完备校正须桌数与局数分母（本包导出件不含），",
                  "故本族名单只作候选，不作判定"), "—")
  add_crit("同桌率", if (is.na(so_c)) "—" else so_c, "同桌注单数（样本量门槛）",
           amt(t_so), "Wilson 反解与实测上限取小者", "同上（与式合取）")
  FAM[["同桌率"]] <- list(tbl = STHIT, ids = ids4, key = "uid1",
    export = "13_玩家_同桌率名录", 对表 = TRUE)
} else {
  FAM[["同桌率"]] <- list(tbl = NULL, ids = character(0), key = "uid1",
    export = "13_玩家_同桌率名录", 对表 = TRUE)
  add_crit("同桌率", "—", "料源缺席", "—", "所待：R02_same_table（§R02）", "—")
}
CRITTBL <- if (length(CRIT)) do.call(rbind, CRIT) else NULL
## 出表助手：一族一表，一表一块（不在循环内出互动件——循环内的 widget 依赖挂不上）
fam_out <- function(nm) {
  f <- FAM[[nm]]
  if (is.null(f)) return(kb(data.frame(状态 = "⬜ 该族未生成（料源缺席）"), caption = nm))
  note <- paste0("本表列出该族命中记录的**全部维度**，一列不删；",
    if (isTRUE(f$对表)) "本族以**会员对**为记录单位，故一行两名会员；" else "",
    if (isTRUE(f$画像)) "**画像口径**：其经济量不计入漏损合计（E1 已裁定其优势未能证实）；" else "",
    "名单性质为**调查候选**，须人工复核与结构证据方可定性")
  dt_all(f$tbl, caption = sprintf("玩家 · %s 命中名录（全维度）", nm),
         note = note, export = f$export)
}
gc2(); mem("四族判定毕")
```

# 三、玩家：领域雷达 · 能力值名单 · 四族名录 · 营业额与盈亏 {#sec-player}

```{r}
#| label: player-cap
# echo: false
## ══ 玩家十维原始量 → 分位归一 → 领域分（罚侧同向化）→ 综合分（赏−罚，口径不改）
PL <- NULL; PDIM_OK <- character(0); NP <- NULL
agg_sum <- function(keys, vals) {
  s <- tapply(numv(vals), as.character(keys), sum, na.rm = TRUE)
  data.frame(id = names(s), v = as.numeric(s), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
if (!is.null(K01) && "member_id" %in% names(K01)) {
  PL <- data.frame(member_id = as.character(K01$member_id), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else if (!is.null(B01)) {
  PL <- data.frame(member_id = unique(as.character(B01$member_id)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
if (!is.null(PL)) {
  setdim <- function(nm, v) { PL[[nm]] <<- v; PDIM_OK <<- unique(c(PDIM_OK, nm)) }
  ## D06 流水贡献
  if (!is.null(K01) && all(c("validbet","hedge_rate") %in% names(K01)))
    setdim("流水贡献", numv(K01$validbet) * (1 - pmin(pmax(numv(K01$hedge_rate), 0), 1)))
  ## D07 游戏输赢贡献（平台视角）
  if (!is.null(B01)) {
    g <- agg_sum(B01$member_id, B01$game_pnl)
    setdim("游戏输赢贡献", -g$v[match(PL$member_id, g$id)])
    ## 在册跨度与末次下注
    dtv <- as.numeric(as.Date(B01$bet_date))
    f <- tapply(dtv, as.character(B01$member_id), min, na.rm = TRUE)
    l <- tapply(dtv, as.character(B01$member_id), max, na.rm = TRUE)
    nd <- tapply(as.character(B01$bet_date), as.character(B01$member_id),
                 function(z) length(unique(z)))
    span <- as.numeric(l[PL$member_id]) - as.numeric(f[PL$member_id]) + 1
    lastd <- as.numeric(l[PL$member_id])
    ndays <- if (!is.null(K01) && "n_days" %in% names(K01)) numv(K01$n_days)
             else as.numeric(nd[PL$member_id])
    setdim("活跃稳定", ndays / pmax(span, 1))
    wend <- suppressWarnings(max(dtv, na.rm = TRUE))
    setdim("生命周期阶段", span * exp(-pmax(wend - lastd, 0) / 14))
  }
  ## D04 投注产品结构熵
  if (!is.null(K01) && "side_entropy" %in% names(K01)) setdim("投注产品结构熵", numv(K01$side_entropy))
  ## D08 索提诺稳定性（平台视角日收益：均值 ÷ 下行标准差）
  if (!is.null(B01) && all(c("net_pnl","validbet") %in% names(B01))) {
    r <- -numv(B01$net_pnl) / pmax(numv(B01$validbet), 1)
    kk <- as.character(B01$member_id)
    nn <- tapply(r, kk, function(z) sum(is.finite(z)))
    mu <- tapply(r, kk, function(z) mean(z[is.finite(z)]))
    dn <- tapply(r, kk, function(z) { z <- z[is.finite(z) & z < 0]
                                      if (length(z) > 1) stats::sd(z) else NA_real_ })
    so <- ifelse(as.numeric(nn[PL$member_id]) >= 5 & is.finite(as.numeric(dn[PL$member_id])) &
                 as.numeric(dn[PL$member_id]) > 0,
                 as.numeric(mu[PL$member_id]) / as.numeric(dn[PL$member_id]), NA_real_)
    setdim("索提诺稳定性", so)
  }
  ## D08 对打指数 · D11 批量注册嫌疑
  if (!is.null(C06) && all(c("m_a","m_b") %in% names(C06))) {
    orv <- if ("opposite_rate" %in% names(C06)) numv(C06$opposite_rate) else rep(NA_real_, nrow(C06))
    lg <- data.frame(id = c(as.character(C06$m_a), as.character(C06$m_b)),
                     or = c(orv, orv),
                     gap = suppressWarnings(abs(numv(C06$m_a) - numv(C06$m_b))),
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    mo <- tapply(lg$or, lg$id, function(z) suppressWarnings(max(z, na.rm = TRUE)))
    mg <- tapply(lg$gap, lg$id, function(z) suppressWarnings(min(z, na.rm = TRUE)))
    v1 <- as.numeric(mo[PL$member_id]); v1[!is.finite(v1)] <- 0
    setdim("对打指数", v1)
    v2 <- 1 / (1 + as.numeric(mg[PL$member_id])); v2[!is.finite(v2)] <- 0
    setdim("批量注册嫌疑", v2)
  }
  ## D11 IP结构风险
  if (!is.null(IPL) && !is.null(C01) && all(c("bet_ip","member_per_chain") %in% names(C01)) &&
      all(c("member_id","bet_ip") %in% names(IPL))) {
    j <- merge(data.frame(member_id = as.character(IPL$member_id), bet_ip = IPL$bet_ip,
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
               data.frame(bet_ip = C01$bet_ip, mpc = numv(C01$member_per_chain),
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE), by = "bet_ip")
    mm <- tapply(j$mpc, j$member_id, function(z) suppressWarnings(max(z, na.rm = TRUE)))
    v3 <- as.numeric(mm[PL$member_id]); v3[!is.finite(v3)] <- 0
    setdim("IP结构风险", v3)
  }
  ## D08 人工标记史
  if (!is.null(SEED) && "member_id" %in% names(SEED))
    setdim("人工标记史", as.numeric(PL$member_id %in% as.character(SEED$member_id)))
  ## 分位归一
  if (length(PDIM_OK)) {
    NP <- as.data.frame(lapply(PDIM_OK, function(d) pq(PL[[d]])), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    names(NP) <- PDIM_OK
    dpos <- CAPDICT$维度[CAPDICT$实体 == "玩家" & CAPDICT$赏罚 > 0]
    dneg <- CAPDICT$维度[CAPDICT$实体 == "玩家" & CAPDICT$赏罚 < 0]
    pp <- intersect(PDIM_OK, dpos); nn2 <- intersect(PDIM_OK, dneg)
    PL$赏 <- if (length(pp)) rowMeans(NP[pp], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
    PL$罚 <- if (length(nn2)) rowMeans(NP[nn2], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
    PL$综合分 <- PL$赏 - PL$罚
    message(sprintf("✅ 玩家维度自检：%d/%d 维在位（%s）", length(PDIM_OK),
      sum(CAPDICT$实体 == "玩家"), paste(u8(PDIM_OK), collapse = "、")))
  }
}
## ══ 领域同向化与领域分（三实体共用）
domain_scores <- function(NORM, dims_ok, entity) {
  cd <- CAPDICT[CAPDICT$实体 == entity & CAPDICT$维度 %in% dims_ok, ]
  if (!nrow(cd)) return(NULL)
  doms <- unique(cd$领域ID)
  out <- as.data.frame(lapply(doms, function(d) {
    dd <- cd[cd$领域ID == d, ]
    m <- as.data.frame(lapply(seq_len(nrow(dd)), function(i) {
      v <- NORM[[dd$维度[i]]]
      if (dd$赏罚[i] > 0) v else 100 - v          # 罚侧同向化：越外圈越好
    }))
    rowMeans(m, na.rm = TRUE)
  }), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(out) <- paste0(doms, " ", DOMAIN$领域名[match(doms, DOMAIN$领域ID)])
  attr(out, "领域构成") <- cd
  out
}
PD <- if (!is.null(NP)) domain_scores(NP, PDIM_OK, "玩家") else NULL
```

## 3.1 玩家各领域能力值雷达图 {#sec-player-radar}

```{r}
#| label: radar-player
#| results: asis
# echo: false
if (is.null(PD) || is.null(PL) || !nrow(PL)) {
  ph("数据库/K01_risk_feature_matrix.csv ＋ B01_bt_panel.csv", "§K01 ＋ §B01",
     "玩家领域雷达、玩家能力值名单与玩家侧一切经济核算")
} else {
  allD <- paste0(DOMAIN$领域ID, " ", DOMAIN$领域名)
  have <- names(PD)
  ser_names <- allD
  vals <- function(ix) vapply(allD, function(d)
    if (d %in% have) mean(PD[[d]][ix], na.rm = TRUE) else 0, numeric(1))
  q95 <- stats::quantile(PL$综合分, .95, na.rm = TRUE)
  q05 <- stats::quantile(PL$综合分, .05, na.rm = TRUE)
  grp <- list(`优质组（综合分≥P95）` = which(PL$综合分 >= q95),
              `全体均值`             = seq_len(nrow(PL)),
              `高危组（综合分≤P5）`  = which(PL$综合分 <= q05))
  ser <- lapply(grp, vals)
  names(ser) <- sprintf("%s（%s 人）", names(grp), amt(vapply(grp, length, 1L)))
  pend <- which(!(allD %in% have))
  cat(er_radar(tag = "玩家领域", labels = allD, series = ser,
    cols = c(PAL$good, PAL$ac, PAL$bad), pend = if (length(pend)) pend else NULL,
    title = sprintf("玩家 · 十二领域能力值雷达（在位 %d/12 领域 · %s 人 · 分位 0–100）",
                    length(have), amt(nrow(PL))),
    note = paste0("罚侧维已同向化（100−分位），故**越外圈越好**；标「待表零」之轴系本实体",
                  "在该领域无维，是无证据而非零分；综合分仍照 §17.2 原式赏−罚计")))
}
```

**读法**：十二条轴是**统一领域**，不是维度——领域统一方能跨实体横比（见 @sec-domain）。
绿线（综合分前 5%）应在多数领域外扩，红线（后 5%）应内缩；
两线在 **D08 风险**与 **D11 网络**两轴的分离度，即本套评分对玩家分层是否有效的直接凭据。
标注**待表零**之轴（D02 激活 · D03 充值 · D10 质量 · D12 合规）是本平台的结构性空缺，
`r if (!is.null(PD)) "" else ""`**空着即是信息，不得以邻近维填补**。

## 3.2 玩家各领域能力值名单 {#sec-player-roster}

```{r}
#| label: roster-player
# echo: false
if (is.null(PD) || is.null(PL)) {
  ph("数据库/K01_risk_feature_matrix.csv ＋ B01_bt_panel.csv", "§K01 ＋ §B01", "玩家能力值名单")
} else {
  M <- vapply(FAM, function(z) PL$member_id %in% as.character(z$ids),
              logical(nrow(PL)))
  if (is.null(dim(M))) M <- matrix(M, nrow = nrow(PL))
  colnames(M) <- names(FAM)
  flagv <- rep("—", nrow(PL))
  ixh <- which(rowSums(M) > 0)
  if (length(ixh)) flagv[ixh] <- apply(M[ixh, , drop = FALSE], 1,
    function(rr) paste(colnames(M)[rr], collapse = " ＋ "))
  RO <- bind_roster(
    data.frame(check.names = FALSE, 会员编号 = PL$member_id,
      综合分 = round(PL$综合分, 2), 赏侧均值 = round(PL$赏, 2),
      罚侧均值 = round(PL$罚, 2), 综合分分位 = round(pq(PL$综合分), 1),
      命中风险族 = flagv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    PD, NP[PDIM_OK])
  dt_all(RO, caption = "玩家能力值名单：逐人 × 领域分 × 维度分",
    note = paste0("列分三段：领域段（同向化后，越大越好）、维度段（分位原值，罚侧越大越糟）、",
                  "以及命中风险族标记。按综合分升序排列——**列首者为处置优先级最高者，",
                  "不是「最坏的人」**；综合分只定排队顺序，不定性质"),
    order_by = "综合分", desc = FALSE, export = "20_玩家_能力值名单", len = 12)
}
```

## 3.3 四族风险的判定标准与指标 {#sec-player-crit}

```{r}
#| label: crit-table
# echo: false
if (is.null(CRITTBL)) {
  ph("四族料源（I_ip_player／S_player_tail／C06_hedge_pairs／R02_same_table）",
     "C-00／D-06／§C06fix／§R02", "四族判定标准表与其后全部名录")
} else {
  dt_all(CRITTBL, caption = "四族风险判定标准与指标（阈值一律现算，不得硬编码）",
    note = paste0("每一族皆为**合取式**：分位阈 ∧ 样本量门槛 ∧（异常 IP 另加）条件化闸。",
                  "样本量门槛由 Wilson 区间宽度收敛至 0.15 反解，不由人拍；",
                  "凡阈值来源写「⚠️」者，即该闸本次未能启用，其名单的性质随之降级，已于该行注明"),
    export = "08_四族判定标准", len = 15)
}
```

::: {.callout-important}
## 四族名录的法定性质（三实体一体适用）

- **异常 IP**：多账户共处同一网络位置且该位置塞号密度居于分布顶端者。
  **必须条件化**——不滤 CGNAT 与公共出口，榜首会被电信基础设施占据，那不是团伙。
- **尾秒下注**：主方案 §E1 五重检验已裁定其信息优势**未能证实**（含 Simpson 分解与符号检验）。
  故本族**只作画像**，其经济量**不计入漏损合计**——不因均值好看而硬留。
- **对打**：同局一庄一闲、反向下注率达完全反向者。这是**洗码套利**的指纹，
  其漏损出在**退水与占成**，不出在赌桌输赢。
- **同桌率**：裸同桌率会被活跃度污染——桌少人多时高同桌率是天然结果。
  本次仅以相对倍数作**代理校正**，完备校正须桌数与局数分母（本包不含），
  故本族一律只作**候选**，不作判定。
:::

## 3.5 玩家侧结账：营业额与盈亏各损失多少 {#sec-player-econ}

```{r}
#| label: econ-player
# echo: false
if (is.null(B01)) {
  ph("数据库/B01_bt_panel.csv", "§B01", "三实体全部营业额与盈亏核算")
} else {
  rows <- list(econ_row(ECON_ALL, "【基准】全体会员", "全窗口全体"))
  for (nm in names(FAM)) {
    e <- econ_ids(FAM[[nm]]$ids, nm)
    if (!is.null(e)) rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- econ_row(e,
      paste0(nm, if (isTRUE(FAM[[nm]]$画像)) "（画像·不计入合计）" else ""), "会员直接口径")
  }
  ## 去重合计：三族（尾秒画像除外）取并集，容斥后一次性核算
  cnt <- setdiff(names(FAM), names(FAM)[vapply(FAM, function(z) isTRUE(z$画像), TRUE)])
  uni <- unique(unlist(lapply(cnt, function(nm) as.character(FAM[[nm]]$ids))))
  eu <- econ_ids(uni, "去重并集")
  if (!is.null(eu)) rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- econ_row(eu,
    paste0("【合计】", paste(cnt, collapse = " ∪ "), "（去重并集）"), "容斥去重后一次核算")
  ECONTBL <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  dt_all(ECONTBL, caption = "玩家侧：四族在营业额与盈亏两侧的量（渲染现算）",
    note = paste0("营业额＝有效投注（洗码量）；GGR＝−Σgame_pnl；NGR₂＝−Σnet_pnl；",
                  "退水支出＝GGR−NGR₂。**会计差额**＝（全体 NGR₂ 率 − 该群体 NGR₂ 率）× 该群体洗码量，",
                  "读作「若该群体表现同于全体，平台本可多得多少」——**情景基准下的差额，非因果损失**。",
                  "合计一律取去重并集，**绝不逐族相加**：同一会员可同时命中数族，相加即重复计算"),
    export = "30_玩家_经济结账", len = 12)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: overlap-player
# echo: false
if (length(FAM) > 1) {
  ks <- names(FAM)
  OV <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ks, function(a) {
    row <- data.frame(check.names = FALSE, 风险族 = a,
                      命中人数 = amt(length(unique(as.character(FAM[[a]]$ids)))),
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    for (b in ks) row[[paste0("∩ ", b)]] <-
      amt(length(intersect(as.character(FAM[[a]]$ids), as.character(FAM[[b]]$ids))))
    row
  }))
  dt_all(OV, caption = "四族命中集合的重叠矩阵（容斥核算之凭据）",
    note = paste0("对角线为各族自身规模，非对角为两族交集。重叠愈大，逐族相加的重复计算愈严重——",
                  "这正是合计一律取去重并集的理由。若某两族交集恒为零，须先怀疑**是否根本没有命中**，",
                  "而不是急于断言二者独立"),
    export = "31_玩家_族间重叠")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tail-verdict
# echo: false
## 尾秒一族：不止不计入合计，还须把「为何不计入」的检验结果摆出来
TV <- NULL
if (!is.null(TAIL) && all(c("tail_roi") %in% names(TAIL))) {
  d <- numv(TAIL$tail_roi)
  if ("norm_game_pnl" %in% names(TAIL) && "tail_stake" %in% names(TAIL) &&
      "tail_game_pnl" %in% names(TAIL)) {
    roi_t <- numv(TAIL$tail_game_pnl) / pmax(numv(TAIL$tail_stake), 1)
    d <- roi_t
  }
  d <- d[is.finite(d)]
  if (length(d) >= 30) {
    bt <- suppressWarnings(stats::binom.test(sum(d > 0), length(d), 0.5))
    tt <- suppressWarnings(stats::t.test(d))
    TV <- data.frame(check.names = FALSE,
      检验 = c("符号检验（尾段 ROI > 0 之比例对 0.5）", "单样本 t 检验（尾段 ROI 均值对 0）"),
      统计量 = c(sprintf("正号 %s / %s（%s）", amt(sum(d > 0)), amt(length(d)),
                        pct(mean(d > 0), 2)),
                 sprintf("t = %.3f，df = %.0f", tt$statistic, tt$parameter)),
      `p 值` = c(formatC(bt$p.value, format = "e", digits = 3),
                 formatC(tt$p.value, format = "e", digits = 3)),
      `95% 区间` = c(paste0(pct(bt$conf.int[1], 2), " ~ ", pct(bt$conf.int[2], 2)),
                     paste0(amt2(tt$conf.int[1]), " ~ ", amt2(tt$conf.int[2]))),
      裁定 = c(if (bt$p.value < 0.05) "在 5% 水平上偏离 0.5" else "**未能拒绝**「与掷硬币无异」",
               if (tt$p.value < 0.05) "均值在 5% 水平上异于 0" else "**未能拒绝**「均值为 0」"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
}
if (is.null(TV)) {
  kb(data.frame(check.names = FALSE, 状态 = "⬜ 本次未能复算尾段检验",
     所待 = "S_player_tail.csv（D-06）之 tail_roi／tail_stake／tail_game_pnl 三列",
     说明 = "主方案 §E1 之五重检验裁定不因本表缺席而改变：尾段优势**未能证实**"),
     caption = "尾秒一族：为何不计入漏损合计", escape = FALSE)
} else {
  kb(TV, escape = FALSE, caption = paste0("尾秒一族：本次复算的两项检验",
    "｜解释：p 值大即「碰巧」的可能性不低，不足以支持尾段有信息优势",
    "｜本报告用途：此即该族经济量不计入漏损合计的凭据，非仅援引旧结论"))
}
```

::: {.callout-warning}
## 三句必须与上表并读的话

**其一，营业额不是损失。** 命中群体的洗码量是**敞口**，不是漏出去的钱——
该群体照样在贡献毛利。把敞口当损失，是本行业最常见的一处夸大。

**其二，会计差额不是因果损失。** 上表的差额答的是「若他们表现同于全体」，
而不是「若他们不这么做」。二者之别即 **E3 与 E5 之别**：
前者只需一次聚合，后者须处置台账、平行趋势与随机对照。

**其三，对打族的钱不在赌桌上。** 其游戏输赢趋近于零而退水照领——
故其漏损须看**退水支出**一列，不是看 GGR。
处置亦随之：**调返水档位与结算复核，不是封号**。
:::

# 四、荷官：领域雷达 · 能力值名单 · 四族归因名录 · 营业额与盈亏 {#sec-dealer}

::: {.callout-important}
## 先立口径：荷官侧一律是**归因**，不是行为

荷官的四族风险量，**不是荷官自己做的事**，而是「其在场时段、其桌上的玩家做了什么」
汇总而来。故荷官名录的正确读法是：**先查玩家，再看这些玩家为何总落在同一位荷官的桌上**。
罚侧四维与四族归因**皆是抽查线索，不是定罪证据**——
桌面盈亏更不可直读作荷官贡献：限红、客群、时长、桌位、产品皆不同，
高毛利可能只是坐在好桌上。
:::

```{r}
#| label: dealer-cap
# echo: false
DE <- NULL; DDIM_OK <- character(0); ND <- NULL; DEALER_STAKE <- NULL
if (!is.null(R03) && all(c("dealer_id","uid") %in% names(R03))) {
  r <- R03
  stk <- col1(r, c("stake_amount","validbet","stake"), "关联投注额", "R03_player_dealer")
  pfl <- col1(r, c("profit_amount","net_pnl","game_pnl"), "关联盈亏", "R03_player_dealer")
  r$.stake <- if (is.na(stk)) NA_real_ else numv(r[[stk]])
  r$.prof  <- if (is.na(pfl)) NA_real_ else numv(r[[pfl]])
  r$dealer_id <- as.character(r$dealer_id); r$uid <- as.character(r$uid)
  gsum <- function(v, k) { s <- tapply(v, k, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
                           data.frame(id = names(s), v = as.numeric(s), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) }
  a1 <- gsum(r$.stake, r$dealer_id)
  DE <- data.frame(dealer_id = a1$id, 在桌洗码量 = a1$v, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  DDIM_OK <- "在桌洗码量"
  nb <- tapply(r$uid, r$dealer_id, function(z) length(unique(z)))
  DE$客群广度 <- as.numeric(nb[DE$dealer_id]); DDIM_OK <- c(DDIM_OK, "客群广度")
  pf <- gsum(r$.prof, r$dealer_id)
  DE$桌面盈亏_平台 <- -pf$v[match(DE$dealer_id, pf$id)]
  ## 特定玩家复现率：前五大客注额 ÷ 在桌洗码量
  top5 <- tapply(seq_len(nrow(r)), r$dealer_id, function(ix) {
    s <- tapply(r$.stake[ix], r$uid[ix], sum, na.rm = TRUE)
    s <- sort(s, decreasing = TRUE)
    sum(utils::head(s, 5), na.rm = TRUE) / max(sum(s, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  })
  DE$特定玩家复现率 <- as.numeric(top5[DE$dealer_id]); DDIM_OK <- c(DDIM_OK, "特定玩家复现率")
  ## 归因三维：对打局占比 · 异常对关联 · 風險單密度
  hedge_ids <- as.character(FAM[["对打"]]$ids)
  if (length(hedge_ids)) {
    ish <- r$uid %in% hedge_ids
    hs <- tapply(ifelse(ish, r$.stake, 0), r$dealer_id, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
    hn <- tapply(ifelse(ish, r$uid, NA_character_), r$dealer_id,
                 function(z) length(unique(z[!is.na(z)])))
    DE$对打局占比 <- as.numeric(hs[DE$dealer_id]) / pmax(DE$在桌洗码量, 1)
    DE$异常对关联 <- as.numeric(hn[DE$dealer_id]) / pmax(DE$客群广度, 1)
    DDIM_OK <- c(DDIM_OK, "对打局占比", "异常对关联")
  }
  if (!is.null(SEED) && "member_id" %in% names(SEED)) {
    iss <- r$uid %in% as.character(SEED$member_id)
    ss <- tapply(ifelse(iss, r$.stake, 0), r$dealer_id, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
    DE$風險單密度 <- as.numeric(ss[DE$dealer_id]) / pmax(DE$在桌洗码量, 1)
    DDIM_OK <- c(DDIM_OK, "風險單密度")
  }
  DEALER_STAKE <- r[, c("dealer_id","uid",".stake",".prof")]
  ## 当值时长与节奏稳定度：须日粒度件
  if (!is.null(R03b) && all(c("dealer_id","bet_date") %in% names(R03b))) {
    rb <- R03b; rb$dealer_id <- as.character(rb$dealer_id)
    nd <- tapply(as.character(rb$bet_date), rb$dealer_id, function(z) length(unique(z)))
    DE$当值时长 <- as.numeric(nd[DE$dealer_id]); DDIM_OK <- c(DDIM_OK, "当值时长")
    if ("n_rounds_eff" %in% names(rb)) {
      key <- paste(rb$dealer_id, as.character(rb$bet_date), sep = "\u0001")
      dr <- tapply(numv(rb$n_rounds_eff), key, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
      dd <- data.frame(dealer_id = sub("\u0001.*$", "", names(dr)),
                       v = as.numeric(dr), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      cvv <- tapply(dd$v, dd$dealer_id, function(z) {
        m <- mean(z, na.rm = TRUE); s <- stats::sd(z)
        if (!is.finite(m) || m <= 0 || !is.finite(s)) NA_real_ else s / m })
      DE$节奏稳定度 <- 1 / (1 + as.numeric(cvv[DE$dealer_id]))
      DDIM_OK <- c(DDIM_OK, "节奏稳定度")
    }
  }
  DDIM_OK <- intersect(CAPDICT$维度[CAPDICT$实体 == "荷官"], DDIM_OK)
  if (length(DDIM_OK)) {
    ND <- as.data.frame(lapply(DDIM_OK, function(d) pq(DE[[d]])), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    names(ND) <- DDIM_OK
    dpos <- CAPDICT$维度[CAPDICT$实体 == "荷官" & CAPDICT$赏罚 > 0]
    dneg <- CAPDICT$维度[CAPDICT$实体 == "荷官" & CAPDICT$赏罚 < 0]
    pp <- intersect(DDIM_OK, dpos); nn2 <- intersect(DDIM_OK, dneg)
    DE$赏 <- if (length(pp)) rowMeans(ND[pp], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
    DE$罚 <- if (length(nn2)) rowMeans(ND[nn2], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
    DE$综合分 <- DE$赏 - DE$罚
    message(sprintf("✅ 荷官维度自检：%d/%d 维在位（%s）", length(DDIM_OK),
      sum(CAPDICT$实体 == "荷官"), paste(u8(DDIM_OK), collapse = "、")))
  }
}
DD <- if (!is.null(ND)) domain_scores(ND, DDIM_OK, "荷官") else NULL
gc2(); mem("荷官能力值毕")
```

## 4.1 荷官各领域能力值雷达图 {#sec-dealer-radar}

```{r}
#| label: radar-dealer
#| results: asis
# echo: false
if (is.null(DD) || is.null(DE) || !nrow(DE)) {
  ph("数据库/R03_player_dealer.csv（＋ R03b_player_dealer_daily.csv）", "§R03（＋§R03b）",
     "荷官领域雷达、荷官能力值名单与荷官侧一切归因")
} else {
  allD <- paste0(DOMAIN$领域ID, " ", DOMAIN$领域名); have <- names(DD)
  vals <- function(ix) vapply(allD, function(d)
    if (d %in% have) mean(DD[[d]][ix], na.rm = TRUE) else 0, numeric(1))
  q95 <- stats::quantile(DE$综合分, .95, na.rm = TRUE)
  q05 <- stats::quantile(DE$综合分, .05, na.rm = TRUE)
  grp <- list(`优质组（综合分≥P95）` = which(DE$综合分 >= q95),
              `全体均值`             = seq_len(nrow(DE)),
              `高危组（综合分≤P5）`  = which(DE$综合分 <= q05))
  ser <- lapply(grp, vals)
  names(ser) <- sprintf("%s（%s 位）", names(grp), amt(vapply(grp, length, 1L)))
  pend <- which(!(allD %in% have))
  cat(er_radar(tag = "荷官领域", labels = allD, series = ser,
    cols = c(PAL$good, PAL$ac, PAL$bad), pend = if (length(pend)) pend else NULL,
    title = sprintf("荷官 · 十二领域能力值雷达（在位 %d/12 领域 · %s 位 · 分位 0–100）",
                    length(have), amt(nrow(DE))),
    note = paste0("罚侧维已同向化，越外圈越好；荷官侧全部维度皆为**过程项**——",
                  "短期输赢是波动，故雷达上没有「输赢」这条轴，也不该有")))
}
```

**读法**：荷官雷达上**没有盈亏轴**，这是设计而非遗漏——荷官的短期输赢是波动，
把它算进绩效，等于用运气考核人。可用者只有 **D06 收入**（在桌洗码量）、
**D04 活跃**（客群广度）、**D09 效率**（当值时长 · 节奏稳定度）、
**D08 风险**与 **D11 网络**（皆为归因项）。
须并读一处实测局限：**局速在数学上不可算**——本包无开台／收台时戳，日期只到日粒度，
分母无从取得，故以**节奏稳定度**作过程代理，它衡量「稳不稳」，不衡量「快不快」，二者不可互替。

```{r}
                  "桌面盈亏受限红、客群、桌位与产品左右，直读即以运气考核人。",
                  "按综合分升序：列首者为抽查优先级最高者"),
```

## 4.3 荷官四族归因：判定标准与名录 {#sec-dealer-lists}

```{r}
#| label: dealer-attr
# echo: false
DATTR <- NULL; DCRIT <- NULL
if (!is.null(DEALER_STAKE) && !is.null(DE)) {
  base <- data.frame(dealer_id = DE$dealer_id, 在桌洗码量 = DE$在桌洗码量,
                     客群广度 = DE$客群广度, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  t_scale <- qthr(base$在桌洗码量, .50)     # 规模门槛：小样本荷官不入名单
  mk <- function(ids, nm) {
    ids <- as.character(ids)
    if (!length(ids)) return(NULL)
    sel <- DEALER_STAKE$uid %in% ids
    st <- tapply(ifelse(sel, DEALER_STAKE$.stake, 0), DEALER_STAKE$dealer_id, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
    pf <- tapply(ifelse(sel, DEALER_STAKE$.prof, 0), DEALER_STAKE$dealer_id, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
    nu <- tapply(ifelse(sel, DEALER_STAKE$uid, NA_character_), DEALER_STAKE$dealer_id,
                 function(z) length(unique(z[!is.na(z)])))
    d <- base
    d$风险族 <- nm
    d$归因命中客数 <- as.numeric(nu[d$dealer_id])
    d$归因客占比 <- d$归因命中客数 / pmax(d$客群广度, 1)
    d$归因投注额 <- as.numeric(st[d$dealer_id])
    d$归因注额占比 <- d$归因投注额 / pmax(d$在桌洗码量, 1)
    d$归因盈亏_平台 <- -as.numeric(pf[d$dealer_id])
    d
  }
  parts <- lapply(names(FAM), function(nm) mk(FAM[[nm]]$ids, nm))
  parts <- parts[!vapply(parts, is.null, TRUE)]
  if (length(parts)) {
    DATTR <- do.call(rbind, parts)
    DATTR$命中 <- FALSE
    for (nm in unique(DATTR$风险族)) {
      ix <- which(DATTR$风险族 == nm)
      tt <- qthr(DATTR$归因注额占比[ix], .99)
      DATTR$命中[ix] <- is.finite(DATTR$归因注额占比[ix]) &
        DATTR$归因注额占比[ix] >= tt & DATTR$在桌洗码量[ix] >= t_scale
      DCRIT <- rbind(DCRIT, data.frame(check.names = FALSE,
        风险族 = nm, 判定指标 = "归因注额占比（该族命中玩家注额 ÷ 该荷官在桌洗码量）",
        计算口径 = "归因口径：其桌上的玩家行为汇总，**非荷官自身行为**",
        本次阈值 = amt2(tt), 阈值来源 = "本窗口荷官分布 P99（现算）",
        规模门槛 = paste0("在桌洗码量 ≥ ", amt(t_scale), "（全体 P50，现算）"),
        命中荷官数 = amt(sum(DATTR$命中[ix], na.rm = TRUE)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
    DATTR$命中[is.na(DATTR$命中)] <- FALSE
  }
}
## 出表助手：一族一表，一表一块
dlr_out <- function(nm) {
  if (is.null(DATTR)) return(kb(data.frame(状态 = "⬜ 荷官归因未生成（料源缺席）"), caption = nm))
  sub <- DATTR[DATTR$风险族 == nm & DATTR$命中, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!is.null(DE)) {
    ## 并表前先剔已在列者，免生 .x／.y 后缀（重复列名读者无从分辨）
    keep <- setdiff(intersect(c(DDIM_OK, "综合分", "赏", "罚"), names(DE)), names(sub))
    if (length(keep)) sub <- merge(sub, DE[, c("dealer_id", keep), drop = FALSE],
                                   by = "dealer_id", all.x = TRUE)
  }
  dt_all(sub, caption = sprintf("荷官 · %s 归因命中名录（全维度）", nm),
    note = paste0("本表含该荷官的全部能力值维度与四项归因量（命中客数 · 客占比 · ",
                  "归因投注额 · 归因注额占比 · 归因盈亏）。",
                  if (isTRUE(FAM[[nm]]$画像)) "**画像口径**：其经济量不计入合计。" else "",
                  "读法：**先查这些玩家，再问他们为何总落在同一桌**"),
    order_by = "归因注额占比", export = paste0("14_荷官_", nm, "_归因名录"))
}
```

## 4.4 荷官侧结账：营业额与盈亏各损失多少 {#sec-dealer-econ}

```{r}
#| label: econ-dealer
# echo: false
if (is.null(DATTR)) {
  ph("数据库/R03_player_dealer.csv", "§R03", "荷官侧经济结账")
} else {
  tot_stake <- sum(DE$在桌洗码量, na.rm = TRUE)
  tot_pf    <- sum(DE$桌面盈亏_平台, na.rm = TRUE)
  rate_all  <- if (tot_stake > 0) tot_pf / tot_stake else NA_real_
  rows <- list(data.frame(check.names = FALSE, 风险族 = "【基准】全体荷官桌面",
    命中荷官数 = amt(nrow(DE)), `归因营业额（注额）` = amt(tot_stake),
    `占全体桌面注额` = pct(1, 2), `归因盈亏（平台视角）` = amt(tot_pf),
    `归因留成率` = pct(rate_all, 3), `全体留成率` = pct(rate_all, 3),
    `会计差额（若同于全体）` = amt(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  for (nm in unique(DATTR$风险族)) {
    s <- DATTR[DATTR$风险族 == nm & DATTR$命中, , drop = FALSE]
    vb <- sum(s$归因投注额, na.rm = TRUE); pf <- sum(s$归因盈亏_平台, na.rm = TRUE)
    rr <- if (vb > 0) pf / vb else NA_real_
    gapv <- if (is.finite(rate_all) && vb > 0) (rate_all - rr) * vb else NA_real_
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(check.names = FALSE,
      风险族 = paste0(nm, if (isTRUE(FAM[[nm]]$画像)) "（画像·不计入合计）" else ""),
      命中荷官数 = amt(nrow(s)), `归因营业额（注额）` = amt(vb),
      `占全体桌面注额` = pct(vb / max(tot_stake, 1), 3),
      `归因盈亏（平台视角）` = amt(pf), `归因留成率` = pct(rr, 3),
      `全体留成率` = pct(rate_all, 3), `会计差额（若同于全体）` = amt(gapv),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  dt_all(do.call(rbind, rows), caption = "荷官侧：四族归因在营业额与盈亏两侧的量",
    note = paste0("**归因营业额**＝该族命中玩家在该荷官桌上的投注额，是**敞口**不是损失；",
                  "**归因盈亏**＝其桌上该族玩家输赢的平台视角合计；",
                  "**留成率**＝归因盈亏 ÷ 归因营业额。三者皆为归因量——",
                  "荷官侧不得逐族相加，亦不得读作荷官造成的损失"),
    export = "32_荷官_经济结账")
}
```

# 五、代理：领域雷达 · 能力值名单 · 四族归因名录 · 营业额与盈亏 {#sec-agent}

```{r}
#| label: agent-cap
# echo: false
AG <- NULL; ADIM_OK <- character(0); NAG <- NULL; MAP3 <- NULL
if (!is.null(IPL) && all(c("member_id","lv3") %in% names(IPL))) {
  MAP3 <- unique(data.frame(member_id = as.character(IPL$member_id),
                            lv3 = as.character(IPL$lv3), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  MAP3 <- MAP3[!is.na(MAP3$lv3) & nzchar(MAP3$lv3), , drop = FALSE]
  MAP3 <- MAP3[!duplicated(MAP3$member_id), , drop = FALSE]   # 一员一线：取首现，重复归属另行登记
  nmem <- tapply(MAP3$member_id, MAP3$lv3, function(z) length(unique(z)))
  AG <- data.frame(lv3 = names(nmem), 线下规模 = as.numeric(nmem), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  ADIM_OK <- "线下规模"
  ## 真实流水
  if (!is.null(K01) && all(c("member_id","validbet","hedge_rate") %in% names(K01))) {
    k2 <- data.frame(member_id = as.character(K01$member_id),
                     rv = numv(K01$validbet) * (1 - pmin(pmax(numv(K01$hedge_rate), 0), 1)),
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    k2 <- merge(k2, MAP3, by = "member_id")
    s <- tapply(k2$rv, k2$lv3, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
    AG$真实流水 <- as.numeric(s[AG$lv3]); ADIM_OK <- c(ADIM_OK, "真实流水")
  }
  ## 退水消耗比
  if (!is.null(B01) && all(c("net_pnl","game_pnl") %in% names(B01))) {
    b <- data.frame(member_id = as.character(B01$member_id),
                    reb = numv(B01$net_pnl) - numv(B01$game_pnl),
                    ggr = -numv(B01$game_pnl), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    b <- merge(b, MAP3, by = "member_id")
    r1 <- tapply(b$reb, b$lv3, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
    g1 <- tapply(b$ggr, b$lv3, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
    den <- as.numeric(g1[AG$lv3]); nbad <- sum(den <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (nbad > 0) message(sprintf("ℹ️ 退水消耗比：%d 条线游戏赢利非正，分母按 1 计并点名", nbad))
    AG$退水消耗比 <- as.numeric(r1[AG$lv3]) / pmax(den, 1); ADIM_OK <- c(ADIM_OK, "退水消耗比")
    AG$线下GGR <- den; AG$线下退水 <- as.numeric(r1[AG$lv3])
  }
  ## 对打渗透率
  if (length(as.character(FAM[["对打"]]$ids))) {
    hh <- MAP3[MAP3$member_id %in% as.character(FAM[["对打"]]$ids), , drop = FALSE]
    hc <- table(hh$lv3)
    v <- as.numeric(hc[AG$lv3]); v[is.na(v)] <- 0
    AG$对打渗透率 <- v / pmax(AG$线下规模, 1); ADIM_OK <- c(ADIM_OK, "对打渗透率")
  }
  ## 单链密度
  if (!is.null(C01) && all(c("bet_ip","member_per_chain") %in% names(C01)) &&
      "bet_ip" %in% names(IPL)) {
    li <- unique(data.frame(bet_ip = IPL$bet_ip, lv3 = as.character(IPL$lv3),
                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    li <- merge(li, data.frame(bet_ip = C01$bet_ip, mpc = numv(C01$member_per_chain),
                               stringsAsFactors = FALSE), by = "bet_ip")
    mx <- tapply(li$mpc, li$lv3, function(z) suppressWarnings(max(z, na.rm = TRUE)))
    v <- as.numeric(mx[AG$lv3]); v[!is.finite(v)] <- 0
    AG$单链密度 <- v; ADIM_OK <- c(ADIM_OK, "单链密度")
  }
  ## 下线留存 · 新增会员质量
  if (!is.null(PPM) && all(c("member_id","ym") %in% names(PPM))) {
    pm <- data.frame(member_id = as.character(PPM$member_id), ym = as.character(PPM$ym),
                     net = if ("net_pnl" %in% names(PPM)) numv(PPM$net_pnl) else NA_real_,
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    pm <- merge(pm, MAP3, by = "member_id")
    if (nrow(pm)) {
      rt <- tapply(seq_len(nrow(pm)), pm$lv3, function(ix) {
        g <- pm[ix, ]; ms <- sort(unique(g$ym))
        if (length(ms) < 2) return(NA_real_)
        mean(vapply(seq_len(length(ms) - 1), function(i) {
          s0 <- unique(g$member_id[g$ym == ms[i]]); s1 <- unique(g$member_id[g$ym == ms[i + 1]])
          if (length(s0)) length(intersect(s0, s1)) / length(s0) else NA_real_
        }, numeric(1)), na.rm = TRUE)
      })
      AG$下线留存 <- as.numeric(rt[AG$lv3]); ADIM_OK <- c(ADIM_OK, "下线留存")
      ym0 <- min(pm$ym, na.rm = TRUE)
      fm <- tapply(pm$ym, pm$member_id, min)
      pm$fm <- as.character(fm[pm$member_id])
      nw <- pm[pm$ym == pm$fm & pm$fm > ym0, , drop = FALSE]
      if (nrow(nw)) {
        nq <- tapply(-nw$net, nw$lv3, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
        AG$新增会员质量 <- as.numeric(nq[AG$lv3]); ADIM_OK <- c(ADIM_OK, "新增会员质量")
      }
    }
  }
  ADIM_OK <- intersect(CAPDICT$维度[CAPDICT$实体 == "代理"], ADIM_OK)
  if (length(ADIM_OK)) {
    NAG <- as.data.frame(lapply(ADIM_OK, function(d) pq(AG[[d]])), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    names(NAG) <- ADIM_OK
    dpos <- CAPDICT$维度[CAPDICT$实体 == "代理" & CAPDICT$赏罚 > 0]
    dneg <- CAPDICT$维度[CAPDICT$实体 == "代理" & CAPDICT$赏罚 < 0]
    pp <- intersect(ADIM_OK, dpos); nn2 <- intersect(ADIM_OK, dneg)
    AG$赏 <- if (length(pp)) rowMeans(NAG[pp], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
    AG$罚 <- if (length(nn2)) rowMeans(NAG[nn2], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
    AG$综合分 <- AG$赏 - AG$罚
    message(sprintf("✅ 代理维度自检：%d/%d 维在位（%s）", length(ADIM_OK),
      sum(CAPDICT$实体 == "代理"), paste(u8(ADIM_OK), collapse = "、")))
  }
}
AD <- if (!is.null(NAG)) domain_scores(NAG, ADIM_OK, "代理") else NULL
gc2(); mem("代理能力值毕")
```

```{r}
#| label: agent-coverage
# echo: false
## 归属覆盖率：代理侧一切结账皆以此为分母上限，先说破再看数
if (is.null(MAP3) || is.null(B01)) {
  ph("数据库/I_ip_player.csv（须含 lv3）", "C-00", "代理归属映射与代理侧一切结账")
} else {
  allm <- unique(as.character(B01$member_id))
  cov <- length(intersect(allm, MAP3$member_id)) / max(length(allm), 1)
  vb_all <- sum(numv(B01$validbet), na.rm = TRUE)
  vb_map <- sum(numv(B01$validbet[as.character(B01$member_id) %in% MAP3$member_id]), na.rm = TRUE)
  kb(data.frame(check.names = FALSE,
    `有经济记录的会员数` = amt(length(allm)),
    `可归属到 LV3 线者` = amt(length(intersect(allm, MAP3$member_id))),
    `会员归属覆盖率` = pct(cov, 2),
    `洗码量归属覆盖率` = pct(vb_map / max(vb_all, 1), 2),
    `代理线条数` = amt(nrow(AG %||% data.frame())),
    裁定 = if (cov > 0.99) "✅ 近乎全覆盖：代理侧合计与玩家侧合计可直接对照"
           else "⚠️ 未全覆盖：**代理侧合计必然小于玩家侧合计**，差额即未归属者，不得读作漏算"),
    caption = paste0("代理归属覆盖率（渲染现算）",
      "｜解释：一员一线取首现映射，重复归属者本次只计一次",
      "｜本报告用途：代理侧一切结账之分母上限，先说破再看数"), escape = FALSE)
}
```

## 5.1 代理各领域能力值雷达图 {#sec-agent-radar}

```{r}
#| label: radar-agent
#| results: asis
# echo: false
if (is.null(AD) || is.null(AG) || !nrow(AG)) {
  ph("数据库/I_ip_player.csv（须含 lv3）＋ K01 ＋ B01", "C-00 ＋ §K01 ＋ §B01",
     "代理领域雷达、代理能力值名单与代理侧一切归因")
} else {
  allD <- paste0(DOMAIN$领域ID, " ", DOMAIN$领域名); have <- names(AD)
  vals <- function(ix) vapply(allD, function(d)
    if (d %in% have) mean(AD[[d]][ix], na.rm = TRUE) else 0, numeric(1))
  q95 <- stats::quantile(AG$综合分, .95, na.rm = TRUE)
  q05 <- stats::quantile(AG$综合分, .05, na.rm = TRUE)
  grp <- list(`优质组（综合分≥P95）` = which(AG$综合分 >= q95),
              `全体均值`             = seq_len(nrow(AG)),
              `高危组（综合分≤P5）`  = which(AG$综合分 <= q05))
  ser <- lapply(grp, vals)
  names(ser) <- sprintf("%s（%s 条线）", names(grp), amt(vapply(grp, length, 1L)))
  pend <- which(!(allD %in% have))
  cat(er_radar(tag = "代理领域", labels = allD, series = ser,
    cols = c(PAL$good, PAL$ac, PAL$bad), pend = if (length(pend)) pend else NULL,
    title = sprintf("代理 · 十二领域能力值雷达（在位 %d/12 领域 · %s 条线 · 分位 0–100）",
                    length(have), amt(nrow(AG))),
    note = paste0("罚侧维已同向化，越外圈越好；代理是唯一在 **D01 获客**有维的实体——",
                  "其赏侧答「这条线养不养家」，罚侧答「这条线干不干净」，二者可同时高")))
}
```

**读法**：代理的两副面孔可以同时成立——**赏侧高（养家）与罚侧高（不干净）并不矛盾**，
处置随之分立：**佣金照结（赏侧，可等），结算复核照做（罚侧，不能等）**。
罚侧三维中，**退水消耗比**是洗码链的命门：线下退水支出吃掉线下毛利者，
其漏损出在成本结构，不出在赌桌——**该调的是返水档位，不是封线**。

## 5.3 代理四族归因：判定标准与名录 {#sec-agent-lists}

```{r}
#| label: agent-attr
# echo: false
AATTR <- NULL; ACRIT <- NULL
if (!is.null(MAP3) && !is.null(AG)) {
  t_size <- qthr(AG$线下规模, .50)
  for (nm in names(FAM)) {
    ids <- as.character(FAM[[nm]]$ids)
    hh <- MAP3[MAP3$member_id %in% ids, , drop = FALSE]
    hc <- table(hh$lv3)
    d <- data.frame(check.names = FALSE, lv3 = AG$lv3, 风险族 = nm,
      线下规模 = AG$线下规模, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    v <- as.numeric(hc[d$lv3]); v[is.na(v)] <- 0
    d$线下命中会员数 <- v
    d$线下渗透率 <- v / pmax(d$线下规模, 1)
    if (!is.null(B01)) {
      bsel <- as.character(B01$member_id) %in% ids
      bm <- data.frame(member_id = as.character(B01$member_id)[bsel],
                       vb = numv(B01$validbet)[bsel], gp = numv(B01$game_pnl)[bsel],
                       np = numv(B01$net_pnl)[bsel], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      bm <- merge(bm, MAP3, by = "member_id")
      if (nrow(bm)) {
        s1 <- tapply(bm$vb, bm$lv3, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
        s2 <- tapply(bm$gp, bm$lv3, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
        s3 <- tapply(bm$np, bm$lv3, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
        d$归因营业额 <- as.numeric(s1[d$lv3]); d$归因营业额[is.na(d$归因营业额)] <- 0
        d$归因GGR <- -as.numeric(s2[d$lv3]);  d$归因GGR[is.na(d$归因GGR)] <- 0
        d$归因NGR2 <- -as.numeric(s3[d$lv3]); d$归因NGR2[is.na(d$归因NGR2)] <- 0
        d$归因退水 <- d$归因GGR - d$归因NGR2
      }
    }
    tt <- qthr(d$线下渗透率, .99)
    d$命中 <- is.finite(d$线下渗透率) & d$线下渗透率 >= tt & d$线下规模 >= t_size
    d$命中[is.na(d$命中)] <- FALSE
    AATTR <- rbind(AATTR, d)
    ACRIT <- rbind(ACRIT, data.frame(check.names = FALSE, 风险族 = nm,
      判定指标 = "线下渗透率（该族命中会员数 ÷ 线下会员数）",
      计算口径 = "归因口径：其线下会员的行为汇总，**非代理自身行为**",
      本次阈值 = amt2(tt), 阈值来源 = "本窗口代理线分布 P99（现算）",
      规模门槛 = paste0("线下规模 ≥ ", amt(t_size), "（全体 P50，现算）"),
      命中线数 = amt(sum(d$命中, na.rm = TRUE)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
}
## 出表助手：一族一表，一表一块
agt_out <- function(nm) {
  if (is.null(AATTR)) return(kb(data.frame(状态 = "⬜ 代理归因未生成（料源缺席）"), caption = nm))
  sub <- AATTR[AATTR$风险族 == nm & AATTR$命中, , drop = FALSE]
  keep <- setdiff(intersect(c(ADIM_OK, "综合分", "赏", "罚"), names(AG)), names(sub))
  if (length(keep)) sub <- merge(sub, AG[, c("lv3", keep), drop = FALSE],
                                 by = "lv3", all.x = TRUE)
  dt_all(sub, caption = sprintf("代理 · %s 归因命中名录（全维度）", nm),
    note = paste0("本表含该线的全部能力值维度与归因量（线下命中会员数 · 线下渗透率 · ",
                  "归因营业额 · 归因 GGR · 归因 NGR₂ · 归因退水）。",
                  if (isTRUE(FAM[[nm]]$画像)) "**画像口径**：其经济量不计入合计。" else "",
                  "处置指向**结算环节**，不涉线下会员账户本身"),
    order_by = "线下渗透率", export = paste0("15_代理_", nm, "_归因名录"))
}
```
